post.summary: This action starts a self-service password reset. Given an e-mail address and no sign-in, it sends a reset-link e-mail through Ninlil.Web.Services.PasswordResetLinkSender when a matching account exists, is not disabled, has an e-mail address, and SMTP and the public base URL are configured. Allows anonymous callers and is rate limited. The response never varies. It is always 200 with the same Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordResult, whichever condition failed, including "no account has this address". An administrator using `UsersController.ResetPassword` may learn whether an account has an e-mail address or whether SMTP is configured, but an anonymous caller must not be able to tell from the response which addresses have accounts. A delivery failure (the SMTP server rejects the message, say) is logged rather than returned as a 500 for the same reason. Neither does its timing, as far as is practical. The e-mail is sent in the background after the response, so a slow SMTP conversation cannot reveal that an account exists. Only the account lookup and the token generation run inline.

post.summary:
This action checks a username and password. It returns the tokens of a completed sign-in
or, for an account with two-factor authentication, a challenge token to submit to
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.TwoFactorLogin(Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorLoginRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken). Returns 401 for a wrong password or a disabled or unknown
account and 423 while the account is locked out. Wrong passwords do not lock an account,
because that would let anyone who knows a username lock it out; the per-address rate
limit slows guessing instead. Only an administrator's or the system's lockout gives 423. Allows anonymous callers and is rate
limited.

This action e-mails the account a short-lived verification code during the pending
second-factor step of a sign-in, for the `"Email"` provider of
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.TwoFactorLogin(Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorLoginRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken). The pending-sign-in token from M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.Login(Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
authorizes it (the caller has no session yet) and stays valid, so the code can be
submitted afterwards. Returns 202 on success; 401 for an unknown, expired or used
token; 400 when the account has no confirmed e-mail address. Returns 429 with a
`Retry-After` header when a code was sent to the account in the last 60 seconds
(by this action or by M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.TwoFactorController.SendEmailCode) or when this
pending sign-in has already asked for 3 codes. Allows anonymous callers and is rate
limited like the other sign-in actions.

This action completes a sign-in that M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.Login(Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) marked as needing a second
factor, checking an authenticator code, an e-mailed code or a recovery code against the
pending sign-in's account. A challenge token that reaches the code check is spent
whether or not the code is right. Returns 401 for an unknown or used challenge token or
a wrong code. After 5 wrong codes in 15 minutes for the account (counted across all
client addresses and shared with Ninlil.Web.Controllers.TwoFactorController) it returns 429
with a `Retry-After` header, without checking the code and without spending the
challenge token. Allows anonymous callers and is rate limited per client address.

This action exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access and refresh token pair and
revokes the old refresh token (rotation), so it cannot be reused. The token comes from
the request body when one is given there, otherwise from the browser's refresh cookie,
in which case the new refresh token goes back as a cookie rather than in the body. The
new session keeps the old one's Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.SessionEntity.IsPersistent choice.
Returns 401 for an invalid, expired or revoked token or a disabled account. Allows
anonymous callers.

A failed cookie exchange leaves the cookie alone. Two tabs reloading together both
    send the same cookie; the first rotates it and the second fails. If that failure
    cleared the cookie, its response would erase the new cookie the first tab just got
    and sign both out. Left alone, the second tab retries with the rotated cookie. A
    dead cookie costs only a 401, and M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.Logout(Ninlil.Web.Models.RefreshRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) clears it.

This action revokes a refresh token, the one named in the body or otherwise the
browser's refresh cookie, which is then cleared. Holding the raw refresh token is enough
to revoke it, so no access token is needed. Always returns 204, even for an unknown
token. Allows anonymous callers.

This action sets a new password from a password-reset token. It is the second step of
both M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest) and the `EmailLink` mode of
`UsersController.ResetPassword`, called from the admin console's "set new password"
page. The caller is not signed in, so it allows anonymous callers;
Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest.Token is the only proof of authorization, and
M:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.UserManager`1.ResetPasswordAsync(`0,System.String,System.String) rejects a wrong, expired or used
token. An unknown account and an undecodable token return the same 400 message, so the
response does not reveal whether an account exists. A successful reset revokes every
refresh token of the account.

This action builds a complete backup archive and returns it as a file download
(`application/octet-stream`, `ninlil-backup-*.ltbk`), not JSON. With
Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupCreateRequest.Passphrase the archive is encrypted with AES-256-GCM;
without one it is unencrypted and marked as such in its header. Returns 400 when the
passphrase is only whitespace or too short. Requires `backup:read`.

requestBody.description: The passphrase to encrypt the archive with; omit it for no encryption.

post.summary:
This action restores the database, Data Protection key ring, TLS certificate and runtime
configuration file from an archive, encrypted or not. All stored data is wiped and
replaced; there is no partial or merge restore. The archive is decrypted, checked and
parsed before anything is written, so a wrong or missing passphrase or a corrupted,
tampered or unrecognized archive returns 400 and leaves the server's data untouched.
Returns 409 when another restore is already running (nothing is changed; try again when
it has finished). On a relational storage engine the wipe and import are one
transaction, so a database failure also leaves the data as it was. The server must
be restarted afterwards to pick up the restored key ring, certificate and settings.
Requires `backup:write`.

Archive.description: This property contains the backup archive to restore from, encrypted or not.

Passphrase.description:
This property contains the passphrase Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupRestoreRequest.Archive was encrypted with, or null
or blank for an unencrypted archive. Whether the archive is encrypted is read from its
header, not inferred from this field.

get.summary:
This action serves the cluster dashboard: a row with this node's query counts (last
hour, last 24 hours, all retained), then one row per known peer, collected live over the
TSIG-authenticated, TLS-encrypted cluster channel by
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.IClusterQueryStatsAggregator. A peer that cannot be reached is still
listed, marked unreachable with null counts, so "no traffic" and "unreachable" look
different. With clustering disabled or no known peers, only this node's row is returned.
Requires `clusternodes:read`.

post.summary:
This action answers a peer's heartbeat with 200, after checking that the body names the
peer the key belongs to and storing a newly announced certificate thumbprint (see
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Cluster.Heartbeat.ClusterHeartbeatReceiver). Each node's `ClusterHeartbeatBackgroundService`
sets a peer's Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.ClusterNodeEntity.Status from whether its own probe of that
peer succeeded, so each node trusts its own view of a peer's health rather than
anything the peer reports. An invite key cannot reach this action.

This action receives the joining node's callback, the second half of the join handshake
(see M:Ninlil.Dns.Server.Cluster.Join.ClusterJoinService.HandleJoinCompleteAsync(System.String,Ninlil.Dns.Server.Cluster.Channel.ClusterJoinCompleteRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)). The TSIG key name comes
from the identity Ninlil.Dns.Server.Cluster.Authentication.ClusterTsigAuthenticationHandler authenticated, never
from the request body. It is the one action an unused, unexpired invite key may sign;
the route must stay Ninlil.Dns.Server.Cluster.Authentication.ClusterTsigAuthenticationDefaults.JoinCompletePath.

This action receives one config-sync envelope from a peer and passes it to the
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.IClusterConfigSyncApplier whose
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.IClusterConfigSyncApplier.EntityType matches
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.ClusterConfigSyncEnvelope.EntityType. Every synced kind of data (filter
lists and entries, access-control rules, rewrites, forwarders, users, roles, settings
sections) comes through this one endpoint.

It always returns 200, even for an entity type this node does not know (logged and
    ignored), so a newer peer sending a kind an older node cannot handle does not look
    like a channel failure. Accepting, rejecting and last-write-wins are decided by the
    applier (see Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.IClusterConfigSyncApplier).

This action tells a peer whether a username exists on this node. A peer's
`ClusterUsernameUniquenessChecker` calls it when creating a user. It is a plain
lookup with no lock or reservation, so two nodes creating the same name within moments
of each other can both succeed; Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.ClusterSyncConflictResolver, applied by
`UserClusterConfigSyncApplier`, resolves and flags that collision once the nodes
sync.

This action returns this node's query counts (last hour, last 24 hours, all retained)
for the cluster dashboard. A peer's `ClusterQueryStatsAggregator` calls it when an
operator opens that peer's Cluster page. The counts are computed from the query log on
every call and not cached; a dashboard load can afford that. They are read through a
scope of their own that uses a read replica when one is eligible: a count that is a few
seconds old is invisible next to a query log the writer batches for up to a second.
The request scope cannot choose a replica because the peer authentication has already
read the registry there.

patch.summary:
This action merges a partial update into the `Cluster` section (and, for
`addressReconcileInterval`, the `CatalogSync` section) as an RFC 7396 merge
patch, through Ninlil.Dns.Server.Presets.PresetConfigurationFileApplier. There is no `nodeId`
field. The response note says whether the change applies at once or needs a restart.
Returns 400 for a field of the wrong JSON type, a port outside 0-65535 (0 means the
shared HTTPS port), a missed-heartbeat threshold below 1, a `heartbeatInterval`
outside 1 second to 1 day, a `heartbeatTimeout` outside 1 second to 5 minutes, or
an `addressReconcileInterval` that is not positive or exceeds the timer limit.
Requires `clustersettings:write`.

get.summary:
This action searches the query log, newest first, one page at a time, narrowed by any of
the filters given. Returns 400 for an unknown record type, response code or protocol
version. Requires `querylog:read`.

parameters.name: clientAddress
parameters.description: An exact match on the client address.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: A case-insensitive substring match on the queried name.

parameters.name: queriedType
parameters.description:
An exact match on the queried record type, by enum member name (for example `"A"`
or `"Aaaa"`) or by the name the API returns.

parameters.name: responseCode
parameters.description:
An exact match on the response code, by enum member name (for example `"NxDomain"`)
or by the name the API returns (for example `"NXDOMAIN"`).

parameters.name: fromUtc
parameters.description: The inclusive start of the time range to search.

parameters.name: toUtc
parameters.description: The inclusive end of the time range to search.

parameters.name: clientIdentifier
parameters.description: An exact match on the resolved, persistent client identifier (a MAC address or DUID).

parameters.name: clientProtocolVersion
parameters.description:
An exact match on the resolved client's protocol version (for example `"IPv4"` or
`"IPv6"`), which picks which of the two identifier spaces
clientIdentifier belongs to.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: This property contains how many items to skip before the returned page begins.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: This property contains the maximum number of items to return.

patch.summary:
This action merges a partial update into `DnsServer:Recursive` as an RFC 7396 merge
patch, through Ninlil.Dns.Server.Presets.PresetConfigurationFileApplier. A field absent from
patch keeps its value; an override list, when present, replaces the
whole list. `insecureDomains` is the same, and also accepts `null` to restore the
built-in list. The response note says whether a restart is needed. Returns 400 for a
field of the wrong JSON type, an `upstreamQueryTimeout` outside 100 milliseconds
to 1 minute, an `overallQueryTimeout` outside 1 second to 5 minutes or shorter
than the upstream timeout (the stored value stands in for an absent field), a count
below 1, a refresh interval or window that is not positive, a hold-down or stale age
that is negative, a duration beyond the timer limit or 100 years, an invalid root-hint
address, a malformed trust anchor or an invalid domain name in
`insecureDomains`. Requires
`recursivesettings:write`.

returns 404 when the OpenID Connect scheme is not registered (as M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.SsoController.Get
reports with `enabled: false`), and otherwise redirects (302) to the identity
provider's authorization endpoint. The browser ends up, several redirects later,
wherever `OnTokenValidated` or `OnRemoteFailure` sends it. Allows anonymous
callers.

It is named M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.SsoController.StartChallenge(System.Boolean) rather than `Challenge` so it does

Requires `storage:read`.

post.summary:
This action checks the target database and saves a switch to it, which the next start
applies. It returns 202 at once: nothing is copied and the server keeps its engine.
Requires `storage:manage`.

The request carries per-engine connection fields (a file path for SQLite; host,
    port, database, username, password and encryption mode for the others) rather than a
    free-text connection string. The server builds the connection string with each
    engine's `*ConnectionStringBuilder`. An unreachable target, a target that a
    newer Ninlil upgraded, a request naming MongoDB, or a request made while a read replica
    or cluster setting of the engine in use is configured returns 400 and saves nothing. A
    second request replaces the first. The answer says whether Ninlil points the
    runtime configuration file at the target itself, or the operator must first set
    the storage environment variables.

get.summary:
This action reports the caller's two-factor state: whether two-factor sign-in is
required, whether an authenticator key exists, whether the account has a confirmed
e-mail address, and how many recovery codes remain. The account-security page needs this
endpoint because access tokens carry no two-factor claim (it would go stale as soon as
the setting changed), and `UsersController` exposes the state only to holders of
`users:read`.

post.summary:
This action generates a new TOTP shared secret for the caller and returns it with an
`otpauth://` URI for an authenticator app. M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.TwoFactorController.EnableAuthenticator(Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorCodeRequest) must
confirm it before two-factor sign-in becomes required.

While two-factor sign-in is on with an authenticator secret, the request must carry
    a valid current authenticator code or an unused recovery code (which this call
    uses up) in the body; otherwise this returns 400 and the secret is unchanged. After
    5 wrong codes in 15 minutes (shared with the other code checks of this controller
    and the sign-in) it returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header, without checking
    the code. A
    stolen access token alone then cannot swap in an attacker's secret. First-time
    setup, or setup while two-factor sign-in is off, needs no body.

This action confirms authenticator setup by checking a code from the app, and only then
makes a second factor required at sign-in. Returns 400 for a wrong code and 429, with a
`Retry-After` header, after 5 wrong codes in 15 minutes.

This action stops requiring a second factor at sign-in. It needs a valid authenticator
code as well as the access token. Returns 400 for a wrong code and 429, with a
`Retry-After` header, after 5 wrong codes in 15 minutes.

This action e-mails the caller a short-lived verification code from the e-mail token
provider and returns 202. The account must have a confirmed e-mail address, otherwise
this returns 400. Returns 429 with a `Retry-After` header when a code was sent to
the account in the last 60 seconds, by this action or by the sign-in step. Because it needs a signed-in caller, it cannot be called during the
two-factor step of a sign-in; M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.SendTwoFactorEmailCode(Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorEmailCodeRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) does
that.

This action generates a new batch of single-use recovery codes for the caller and
invalidates any earlier batch. A recovery code is a fallback for the second factor, so
two-factor sign-in must already be enabled; otherwise this returns 400.

This action creates a user account. It first asks every reachable, healthy cluster peer
whether the username exists there and returns 409 if one does; an unreachable peer is
skipped, so user management never blocks on one node being down. A collision that only
shows up later (after a network partition) is resolved when the nodes resync, by the
last-write-wins handling in `UserClusterConfigSyncApplier`. Returns 400 when the
username, e-mail address or password fails validation. Requires `users:write`.

This action returns one user account. Returns 404 for an unknown id. Requires

`users:write`.

This action adds a user to a role, by role name. Returns 400 when the role does not

holder); otherwise this returns 403 naming the missing permissions.

post.summary:
This action grants a user a permission directly, independent of their roles. The
permission string is not checked against `GET /api/permissions`. Requires
`users:write`, and the caller must hold the permission it grants (only a holder of
`*` can grant `*`); otherwise this returns 403 naming the missing permission.

delete.summary:
This action revokes a permission granted to a user directly. Permissions that come from
the user's roles are unaffected. Requires `users:write`.

patch.summary:
This action updates the caller's display name and phone number as an RFC 7396 merge
patch (see Ninlil.Web.Extension.JsonElementMergePatchExtension): an absent field is unchanged,
a JSON `null` clears it, and a string sets it. The e-mail address cannot be changed
here (see Ninlil.Web.Models.UserProfileDetail). Requires only a signed-in caller.

post.summary:
This action changes the caller's password. It requires the current password; a wrong one
returns 400 with Identity's `PasswordMismatch` error. A successful change revokes
every refresh token of the account, including the caller's own session: the request
does not say which session it belongs to, so the caller's access token works until it
expires and the caller then signs in again with the new password. Requires only a
signed-in caller.

This action resets an account's password for an administrator, for an account that
cannot supply its current password as M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.ChangeMyPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ChangePasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) requires.
Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminResetPasswordRequest.Mode picks one of two modes (see
Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode). Requires `users:write`.
<list type="bullet"><item>Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.AutoGenerate sets a generated strong
        password at once, through a reset token and
        M:Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.UserManager`1.ResetPasswordAsync(`0,System.String,System.String) so Identity's usual
        validation and hashing apply, and returns it in this response only. It also revokes
        every refresh token of the account.
    </item><item>Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.EmailLink e-mails the account a link to
        the admin console's "set new password" page, which submits to
        M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ResetPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken). The link carries an
        Identity reset token, Base64Url-encoded for the query string (see
        Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest). The account must have an e-mail
        address, and SMTP and the public base URL the link points at must be
        configured (see `SmtpSettingsController`); otherwise this returns 400
        with a clear message.
    </item></list>

patch.summary:
This action updates a zone's settings as an RFC 7396 merge patch: an absent field is
unchanged, a JSON `null` clears a nullable field, and any other value replaces it.
Returns 400 for an invalid name or PTR prefix length, 404 for an unknown id and 409 when
a new name is taken. Requires `zones:write`.

delete.summary:
This action deletes a zone with all its records and DNSSEC keys. Returns 404 for an
unknown id. Requires `zones:write`.

get.summary:
This action lists the member zone names of an RFC 9432 catalog zone (a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.Catalog zone or a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.SecondaryCatalog copy), read from its stored PTR records.
Requires `zones:read`.

post.summary:
This action makes a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.Primary or
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.CloudPrimary zone that this server originates a member of a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.Catalog zone it also originates. It writes the member's RFC
9432 PTR record into the catalog zone and adds every healthy cluster peer's address to
both zones' `NotifyAddresses`, so the change reaches the cluster without manual
configuration (see M:Ninlil.Dns.Server.Authoritative.CatalogSync.CatalogZoneMembershipService.JoinAsync(System.Guid,System.Guid,System.Threading.CancellationToken)). Requires
`zones:write`.

delete.summary:
This action removes a zone from the catalog zone it belongs to, deleting its member PTR
record there. It does nothing if the zone belongs to no catalog. Requires
`zones:write`.

post.summary:
This action runs one CAA reconciliation pass for the zone now and returns how many
records were added or removed, or why the pass was skipped. The same pass runs
automatically on each `DnsZoneChangedEvent`; running it by hand is useful after
changing the server-wide CAA default. It calls
M:Ninlil.Dns.Server.Acme.Caa.CaaRecordReconciliationService.ReconcileZoneAsync(System.Guid,System.Threading.CancellationToken),
like the automatic path. Returns 404 for an unknown id. Requires `zones:write`.

This action runs one PTR (reverse-zone) sync pass for the zone now, through
M:Ninlil.Dns.Server.Authoritative.Ptr.PtrSyncService.ReconcileZoneAsync(System.Guid,System.Threading.CancellationToken), the same logic the automatic
`DnsZoneChangedEvent` path uses, including RFC 2317 classless-delegation records
when the zone's `PtrIpv4PrefixLength` (or the server-wide default) calls for them.
Returns the records added and removed and the reverse zones touched, or why the pass was
skipped, and 404 for an unknown id. Requires `zones:write`.

get.summary:
This action returns the current zone-signing timing. Requires
`zonesigningsettings:read`.

patch.summary:
This action merges a partial update into `DnsServer:Authoritative:ZoneSigning` as
an RFC 7396 merge patch, through Ninlil.Dns.Server.Presets.PresetConfigurationFileApplier. Every
field takes effect at once. Returns 400 for a malformed duration, a negative inception
offset, or a non-positive validity period, refresh margin or poll interval. Requires
`zonesigningsettings:write`.

hasCertificate.description:
true once the domain has been issued at least one certificate;
                false means none has ever been issued.

issuedAtUtc.description: When the current certificate was issued, or null if Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.HasCertificate is false.

expiresAtUtc.description: When the current certificate expires, or null if Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.HasCertificate is false.

isDueForRenewal.description:
true when the domain has no certificate yet, or its certificate expires
                within `AcmeOptions.RenewBeforeExpiration`. It is computed by
                `AcmeCertificateRenewalService.IsDomainDue`, the check the renewal loop itself uses.

lastFailureAtUtc.description:
When the domain's most recent issuance or renewal attempt failed, or
null if that attempt succeeded or none has been made.

lastFailureMessage.description:
A short description of why the most recent attempt failed, or null
together with Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.LastFailureAtUtc.

AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.description:
This record is one row of the certificate inventory that
`AcmeSettingsController.Certificates` returns: one per domain in
`AcmeOptions.Domains`, with what `IAcmeAccountStore` knows about it.
Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.HasCertificate separates a domain that has never been issued a certificate
from one that simply is not due for renewal yet, whatever Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeCertificateInventoryEntry.IsDueForRenewal
says.

AcmeSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the ACME certificate settings (`AcmeOptions`) that
`GET /api/acme-settings` returns. The server-wide CAA defaults
(`CaaAutoManagementOptions`) are nested under Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeSettingsDetail.CaaAutoManagement; the
per-zone override lives on the zone itself (`ZonesController`). The ACME account's
private key is never exposed over REST, so a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the
same fields this record has.

ActiveMqBrokerSettingsDetail.description:
This record carries the `ActiveMqEventBrokerOptions` settings without `Password`,
for the reason given on Ninlil.Web.Models.RabbitMqBrokerSettingsDetail.

enable.description: Whether the limiter rejects anything. Defaults to true.

permitLimit.description: How many sign-in attempts one client address may make within one Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminLoginRateLimitSettingsDetail.Window. Defaults to 5.

window.description: The fixed window Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminLoginRateLimitSettingsDetail.PermitLimit is counted over, which is also the lockout length. Defaults to five minutes.

AdminLoginRateLimitSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the admin sign-in rate limiter settings
(`AdminLoginRateLimitOptions`) that `GET /api/admin-login-rate-limit-settings`
returns. Nothing in it is secret, so a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same
fields.

AdminPasswordResetMode.description:
This enumeration names the two ways an administrator's password reset (see
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.ResetPassword(System.Guid,Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminResetPasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)) delivers a new credential to a
locked-out account. Both are needed: Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.AutoGenerate works without any SMTP
server, which suits a homelab, while Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.EmailLink lets the account holder pick
a password the administrator never sees, but needs a configured SMTP server (see
`EmailSenderOptions` and `SmtpSettingsController`).

AdminResetPasswordRequest.description:
This class carries the delivery mode for an administrator's password reset (see
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.ResetPassword(System.Guid,Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminResetPasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) and
Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode).

generatedPassword.description:
The generated password, shown only here. Set only when Mode is
Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.AutoGenerate; null for
Ninlil.Web.Models.AdminPasswordResetMode.EmailLink, where the server never learns the new
password.

AdminResetPasswordResult.description: This class carries the outcome of an administrator's password reset.

name.description: The token's human-readable name.

createdAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time the token was issued.

expiresAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time the token stops being valid, or null if it never expires.

consumedAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time a one-time token was used, or null if it has not been.

revokedAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time the token was revoked, or null if it has not been.

ApiTokenSummary.description: This class carries an API token's metadata, without its secret value.

AppearanceSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the server-wide default appearance
(`AppearanceOptions`) that `GET /api/appearance-settings` returns: the palette and
light/dark mode a signed-in user gets when they have not chosen their own.

accessToken.description: The signed JSON Web Token access token.

expiresAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time Ninlil.Web.Models.AuthenticationResult.AccessToken expires.

refreshToken.description: The opaque refresh token, or null when it was delivered as a cookie.

AuthenticationResult.description: This class carries a completed sign-in's issued credentials.

sharedKey.description: The raw shared secret, shown so it can be entered manually.

authenticatorUri.description:
The `otpauth://` URI an authenticator app can scan as a QR code, so the secret need
not be typed.

AuthenticatorSetupResult.description:
This class carries a new TOTP (RFC 6238) authenticator enrollment from
`POST /api/auth/two-factor/authenticator/setup`, before the caller confirms it by
sending a generated code to `POST /api/auth/two-factor/authenticator/enable`.

passphrase.description:
The passphrase to encrypt the archive with, or null or empty for an unencrypted archive
whose header marks it as such (no weak or derived default key is used). A passphrase of
only whitespace is rejected. The server never
stores the passphrase, so losing it means the archive can never be decrypted.

BackupCreateRequest.description: This record is the request body for M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.BackupController.Create(Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupCreateRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken).

totalEntitiesImported.description: The total number of rows imported across every entity type.

entityCounts.description: How many rows of each entity type were imported, by name.

note.description:
Always Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupRestoreResponse.RestartRequiredNote: the restored database connection, Data
Protection key ring and TLS certificate take effect only after a restart.

BackupRestoreResponse.description:
This record is the success response body for
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.BackupController.Restore(Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupRestoreRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken).
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.BackupController.Create(Ninlil.Web.Models.BackupCreateRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken) has no JSON response: it returns the
archive itself as a file download.

description.description: A short description of what enabling this entry blocks.

subscriptionUrl.description:
The third-party domain list this entry subscribes to when enabled.
`BlockedServiceCatalog` documents its source and license.

isEnabled.description:
Whether the entry's managed filter list exists and is enabled. When the request names a
client or client group, it also requires that target to have an assignment of the list.

filterListId.description:
The identifier of the entry's managed `DnsFilterListEntity` when one exists, so the UI
can link to it on the Filter Lists page; otherwise null.

BlockedServiceDetail.description:
This class carries one entry of the curated "blocked services" catalog, with whether it is
enabled. It is the response shape of `GET /api/blocked-services`.

siteTitle.description: The custom browser-tab and page title, or null when unset.

logoDataUri.description: The custom logo as a complete data URI, or null when unset.

BrandingEffectiveDetail.description:
This record is the part of the branding any signed-in caller may read, with no specific
permission, from `GET /api/branding-settings/effective` (the same bar as
`AppearanceSettingsController.GetMine`). Every session needs the title and logo to
render the admin console, and they are not sensitive. The CHAOS-query fields stay behind
`branding:read`.

siteTitle.description:
The custom browser-tab and page title, or null when unset (the admin
console then keeps its built-in title).

logoDataUri.description:
The custom logo as a complete data URI, or null when none has been
uploaded.

hostnameString.description:
The value the server answers a `hostname.bind` or `id.server` CHAOS query with,
when EnableChaosVersionQueries is enabled.

versionString.description:
The value the server answers a `version.bind` or `version.server` CHAOS query
with, when EnableChaosVersionQueries is enabled.

enableChaosVersionQueries.description: Whether the server answers these CHAOS-class identification queries at all.

BrandingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the branding that `GET /api/branding-settings` returns: the site title
and logo from `BrandingOptions`, plus the `AuthoritativeServerOptions` fields that
answer the CHAOS-class `version.bind` and `hostname.bind` TXT queries. Both live
on one settings page because both decide how the server presents itself.

CaaAutoManagementSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the server-wide CAA auto-management defaults
(`CaaAutoManagementOptions`), nested in Ninlil.Web.Models.AcmeSettingsDetail.CaaAutoManagement.

ChangePasswordRequest.description:
This class carries the caller's self-service password change
(M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.ChangeMyPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ChangePasswordRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken)). Ninlil.Web.Models.ChangePasswordRequest.CurrentPassword
is required and checked by `UserManager<TUser>.ChangePasswordAsync`: unlike an
administrator's reset, a caller changing their own password must prove they know it.

clientIdentifier.description: A colon-separated MAC address for an IPv4 identity, or a DUID for an IPv6 one.

address.description:
The most recently observed source IP address this identifier answered from, or
null if none has been recorded yet.

firstSeenUtc.description: When the identifier was first recorded against the device.

lastSeenUtc.description:
When the identifier was last observed, or null if no presence signal
has updated it yet.

macAddress.description:
The MAC address ClientIdentifier embeds (directly, or inside a DHCPv4
client-id or a link-layer DUID), as lowercase colon-separated hexadecimal, or
null when it embeds none.

vendor.description:
The organization IEEE assigned MacAddress's block to, computed when the
response is built. null when there is no MAC, it is randomized, or no registry lists it.

isRandomizedMacAddress.description:
Whether MacAddress is a randomized (locally administered) address, which
is never looked up because it names no manufacturer.

ClientAddressDetail.description:
This class carries one persistent identifier a known client device answers to. It appears
in Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientDetail.Addresses and in the responses of
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientAddressesController.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClientAddressDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

clientIdentifier.description: A colon-separated MAC address for an IPv4 identity, or a DUID for an IPv6 one.

ClientAddressWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to add another address to a known client device
(`POST /api/clients/{clientId}/addresses`). Apart from the first address in
Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientCreateRequest, this is the only way a device gains an identifier. The
request is rejected with `409 Conflict` when the identifier and protocol pair already
belongs to any device, this one included, matching the unique composite index on
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientAddressEntity.

clientIdentifier.description: A colon-separated MAC address for an IPv4 client, or a DUID for an IPv6 one.

displayName.description: An optional, operator-chosen, human-readable name for the client.

clientGroupId.description:
The Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientGroupEntity the client is
explicitly assigned to, or null for none.

isDisabled.description: Whether the client starts out disabled.

comments.description: Optional free-text operator notes about the client.

deviceIconKey.description:
An optional device icon, named by its Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsClientDeviceIconEnum value (for
example `Laptop`); any other value is rejected with a `400`. Omitted or
null leaves the choice unset, so the vendor-based suggestion applies.

isFavorite.description: Whether the client starts out starred as a favorite.

ClientCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to register a known client device
(`POST /api/clients`) with its first address. Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientCreateRequest.ClientIdentifier and
Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientCreateRequest.ProtocolVersion become that address's identity, which cannot change later
(see Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientsController). Further addresses are added through
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientAddressesController.Create(System.Guid,Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientAddressWriteRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken). The device fields that stay
editable are in Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientWriteRequest, used by `PUT` and `PATCH`.

addresses.description: Every persistent identifier the device answers to (see Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientAddressDetail).

displayName.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable name for the client.

clientGroupId.description:
The Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientGroupEntity the client is
explicitly assigned to, or null for none.

comments.description: Optional free-text operator notes about the client.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the client was last updated, or null if never.

pausedUntilUtc.description:
The UTC instant until which the client's pause blocks all of its DNS resolution (see
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientEntity.PausedUntilUtc), or
null when no pause has been set.

isCurrentlyPaused.description:
Whether PausedUntilUtc is still in the future, computed when the
response is built. An expired pause is never cleared from storage, so this flag, not the
timestamp, says whether the client is paused.

lastSeenUtc.description:
The most recent passive sighting of the device on any of its addresses (DHCP, a DNS query,
or a reachable neighbor-table entry), or null if it has never been seen.

isOnline.description:
Whether LastSeenUtc falls within the configured online window. It is
computed when the response is built, so it turns false once a device goes quiet.

isFavorite.description: Whether an operator has starred the client as a favorite.

vendor.description:
The hardware vendor of the device, from the first of its addresses whose MAC address
resolves in the IEEE registries. It is computed when the response is built, so it does not
go stale. null when no address yields one.

isRandomizedMacAddress.description:
Whether every MAC address the device's identifiers embed is a randomized (locally
administered) one. It is reported instead of a vendor, since such an address names no
manufacturer. false when no identifier embeds a MAC at all.

ClientDetail.description:
This class carries a known client device, as returned by the list, get and create
endpoints of `/api/clients`. Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientDetail.Addresses lists every identifier the device
answers to, since one device can have several (a dual-stack device's IPv4 MAC address and
IPv6 DUID, for instance).

null when no pause has been set.

response is built, as for Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientDetail.IsCurrentlyPaused.

ClientGroupListAssignmentWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new list assignment for a client group
(`POST /api/client-groups/{groupId}/list-assignments`). There is no `PUT` or
`PATCH`: an assignment only joins a group to a list and has no other fields, so
assigning a different list means deleting one assignment and creating another.

ClientGroupNetworkDetail.description:
This class carries one client group network, as returned by the list, get, create and
replace endpoints under `/api/client-groups/{groupId}/networks`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClientGroupNetworkDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

cidr.description:
The network in CIDR notation, prefix length included (write a single address as
`/32` or `/128`; a bare address is rejected). null when ClientId is set
instead.

clientId.description:
A DNS-over-HTTPS ClientID label this row matches (see
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientGroupNetworkEntity.ClientId). null when Cidr is set instead.

ClientGroupNetworkWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a network belonging to a
client group (`POST` and `PUT` under `/api/client-groups/{groupId}/networks`).
Exactly one of Cidr and ClientId must be set (see
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientGroupNetworkEntity).

ClientGroupScheduleDetail.description:
This class carries a client group schedule, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints under `/api/client-groups/{groupId}/schedules`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClientGroupScheduleDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

ClientGroupScheduleWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a time-of-day
parental-control schedule assigned to a client group
(`POST` and `PUT` under `/api/client-groups/{groupId}/schedules`). The
fields mean what they mean in Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientScheduleWriteRequest.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the group.

isDefault.description:
Whether this is the fallback group for a client that matches no other group's networks.
Setting it true takes the flag from whichever group holds it, since only
one group may (see Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientGroupsController).

ClientGroupWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a client group
(`POST /api/client-groups`, `PUT /api/client-groups/{id}`).

ClientListAssignmentDetail.description:
This class carries one client list assignment, as returned by the list, get and create
endpoints under `/api/clients/{clientId}/list-assignments`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClientListAssignmentDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

listId.description: The Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsFilterListEntity to assign to the client.

ClientListAssignmentWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new filter-list assignment for a known
client (`POST /api/clients/{clientId}/list-assignments`), the client counterpart of
Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientGroupListAssignmentWriteRequest. There is no `PUT` or
`PATCH`: an assignment only joins a client to a list, so assigning a different list
means deleting one assignment and creating another.

onlineWindow.description: How recently a client must have been seen to be reported online. Defaults to 10 minutes.

flushInterval.description: How often buffered sightings are written to storage. Defaults to 30 seconds.

enableNeighborTableSignal.description: Whether the kernel neighbor table is sampled as a presence signal. Defaults to true.

neighborTablePollInterval.description: How often the kernel neighbor table is sampled. Defaults to 15 seconds.

ClientPresenceSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the client presence settings (`ClientPresenceOptions`)
that `GET /api/client-presence-settings` returns. Nothing in it is secret, so a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

ClientScheduleDetail.description:
This class carries a client schedule, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints
under `/api/clients/{clientId}/schedules`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClientScheduleDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

startTime.description: The local time the blocking window begins, in TimeZoneId.

endTime.description:
The local time the blocking window ends. A time earlier than StartTime
makes a window that crosses midnight (e.g. a 21:00 to 07:00 bedtime); a time equal to it is
rejected.

timeZoneId.description: An IANA time zone identifier (e.g. `"America/New_York"`), checked when saved.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the schedule.

ClientScheduleWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a time-of-day
parental-control schedule for one known client (`POST` and `PUT` under
`/api/clients/{clientId}/schedules`). It is the client counterpart of
Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientGroupScheduleWriteRequest. Unlike a list assignment
(Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientListAssignmentWriteRequest), a schedule has fields of its own, so
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientSchedulesController supports `PUT`.

enable.description: Whether outbound queries carry an ECS option. Defaults to false.

sourcePrefixLengthIPv4.description: How many leading bits of an IPv4 address are sent upstream; also caps an ECS option a client sends. Defaults to 24.

sourcePrefixLengthIPv6.description: How many leading bits of an IPv6 address are sent upstream; also caps an ECS option a client sends. Defaults to 56.

overrideAddress.description:
An address sent in every ECS option instead of the client's, or null
(the default) to use the client's address.

ClientSubnetSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the EDNS Client Subnet settings
(`EdnsClientSubnetOptions`) that `GET /api/client-subnet-settings` returns.
Nothing in it is secret, so a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

totalCount.description: Every known client.

onlineCount.description: Clients with any address seen within OnlineWindow.

offlineCount.description: Clients not seen within OnlineWindow, including clients never seen; computed as total minus online.

newCount.description: Clients registered at or after NewSinceUtc.

favoriteCount.description: Clients an operator has starred as a favorite.

newSinceUtc.description: The instant NewCount counts from: the request's `newSinceUtc`, or 24 hours ago when it was omitted.

onlineWindow.description: The online window the presence counts were evaluated against.

ClientSummaryDetail.description:
This class carries the headline counts of the known-client registry
(`GET /api/clients/summary`). Each is counted in storage with the same filters
`GET /api/clients` uses, so a count agrees with the list it links to.

displayName.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable name for the client.

clientGroupId.description:
The Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientGroupEntity the client is
explicitly assigned to, or null for none.

comments.description: Optional free-text operator notes about the client.

deviceIconKey.description:
The device icon, named by its Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsClientDeviceIconEnum value, or
null to clear an explicit choice; any other value is rejected with a
`400`.

isFavorite.description: Whether the client is starred as a favorite.

ClientWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the editable fields of a known client, replaced in full by
`PUT /api/clients/{id}`. It has no Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientCreateRequest.ClientIdentifier
or Ninlil.Web.Models.ClientCreateRequest.ProtocolVersion, because
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ClientsController never lets an address's identity change. To change one, add
a new address and delete the old one, as with the shared secret of a
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.TsigKeyEntity.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the credential set.

credentials.description:
The secret material, keyed by field name; the keys depend on Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialCreateRequest.ProviderType.
It is stored encrypted, and the values are returned once, in this endpoint's response.

isDisabled.description: Whether the credential set starts out disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the credential set.

CloudProviderCredentialCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new cloud DNS provider credential set
(`POST /api/cloud-provider-credentials`).

secrets.description: The secret material as submitted, keyed by field name.

CloudProviderCredentialCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a newly created cloud DNS provider credential set with its plaintext
secrets. It is the only response that includes Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialCreateResponse.Secrets: like every
secret-bearing entity, a secret is revealed once at creation and omitted afterwards.

CloudProviderCredentialDetail.description:
This class carries a cloud DNS provider credential set without its secrets, as returned by
the list and get endpoints and nested in
Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialCreateResponse, the one response that includes the
secrets.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

CloudProviderCredentialDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: The credential set's name.

credentials.description: The secret material, replacing what is stored.

isDisabled.description: Whether the credential set is disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the credential set.

CloudProviderCredentialWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to fully replace an existing cloud DNS provider
credential set (`PUT /api/cloud-provider-credentials/{id}`). Unlike the shared secret
of a TSIG key (see Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyWriteRequest), these secrets come from the
operator, who rotates them at the provider, so a `PUT` replaces
Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialWriteRequest.Credentials along with every other field. Nothing new is revealed, since the
caller supplies the values. To change only the name, comments or disabled flag, use
`PATCH` and leave out `credentials`.

clusterNodeRegistryId.description:
The id of the peer's row in this node's registry, or null for the
answering node, which has no row for itself.

isSelf.description: Whether this row describes the node answering the request.

reachable.description: Whether a live snapshot was collected for this row.

queriesLastHour.description: How many queries this node logged in the last hour, or null when unreachable.

queriesLast24Hours.description: How many queries this node logged in the last 24 hours, or null when unreachable.

totalRetainedQueries.description: How many query-log rows this node currently retains, or null when unreachable.

ClusterAggregateQueryStatsDetail.description:
This class carries one node's query statistics for the cluster dashboard
(`GET /api/cluster/nodes/stats`). A row is either the answering node
(Ninlil.Web.Models.ClusterAggregateQueryStatsDetail.IsSelf is true and it is always Ninlil.Web.Models.ClusterAggregateQueryStatsDetail.Reachable)
or a known peer. A peer whose snapshot could not be collected is reported unreachable
rather than left out (see
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.ClusterSync.IClusterQueryStatsAggregator).

inviteCode.description: The opaque code to hand to the operator of the joining node.

expiresAtUtc.description: The UTC moment after which the code can no longer be used.

ClusterInviteCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a new invite's opaque code and expiry
(`POST /api/cluster/nodes/invite`). The code contains the cluster's shared TSIG secret
in plaintext; this response is the one place that secret is revealed (see
`ClusterInviteCode`).

inviteCode.description: The opaque code copied from the Cluster page of the inviting node.

displayName.description:
An optional display name for the inviter's new row in this node's registry. When omitted,
a name derived from the inviter's node identifier is used.

ClusterJoinRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to consume an invite code and join a cluster
(`POST /api/cluster/nodes/join`).

ClusterNodeDetail.description:
This class carries a peer node in this node's cluster registry, as returned by
`GET /api/cluster/nodes` and `GET /api/cluster/nodes/{id}`. The shared secret of
the peer's TSIG key is never included; Ninlil.Web.Models.ClusterNodeDetail.TsigKeyName only names the key, as
`TsigKeyDetail` omits its secret.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ClusterNodeDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: The peer's operator-chosen display name, or null to keep it.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the peer, or null to keep them.

ClusterNodeWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields an operator may edit on an existing peer row
(`PATCH /api/cluster/nodes/{id}`): only the display name and notes. The address, TSIG
key and pinned certificate are set by the join handshake and cannot be edited, because
changing them would break the trust between the two nodes.

enable.description: Whether clustering is on. Defaults to false.

nodeId.description: This node's identifier, generated at first startup.

advertisedHost.description: The host name or address peers use to reach this node. Empty by default, which makes invites fail until it is set.

advertisedPort.description: The TCP port peers use to reach this node. Defaults to 0, which means the web server's HTTPS port.

heartbeatInterval.description: How often each peer is probed. Defaults to 30 seconds.

heartbeatTimeout.description: How long one probe may take. Defaults to 10 seconds.

missedHeartbeatThreshold.description: How many consecutive failed probes mark a peer unreachable. Defaults to 3.

addressReconcileInterval.description: How often catalog zone address lists are reconciled with cluster membership. Defaults to 1 minute.

ClusterSettingsDetail.description:
This class carries this node's cluster settings (`GET /api/cluster-settings`), from
`ClusterOptions`. Ninlil.Web.Models.ClusterSettingsDetail.NodeId is read-only and shown for diagnostics;
`ClusterSettingsController.Patch` cannot change it. Ninlil.Web.Models.ClusterSettingsDetail.AddressReconcileInterval
comes from `CatalogSyncOptions` instead. It shares this page because it only exists to
keep the NOTIFY and primary address lists of catalog-managed zones in step with cluster
membership (see `CatalogClusterAddressSyncService`).

userId.description: The account the reset applies to, carried in the landing page's link.

token.description:
The password-reset token from `UserManager<TUser>.GeneratePasswordResetTokenAsync`,
Base64Url-encoded because a raw Identity token can contain `+`, `/` and
`=`, which are unsafe in a URL query string. The action decodes it before checking it.

newPassword.description: The new password to set, once Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest.Token checks out.

ConfirmPasswordResetRequest.description:
This class carries a token-based password reset, submitted from the "set new password"
landing page to M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ResetPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest,System.Threading.CancellationToken). The page serves
both the reset e-mail an administrator sends (`UsersController.ResetPassword` in
`EmailLink` mode) and the self-service
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest) request. Nobody is signed in at
this point, so the action is `[AllowAnonymous]` and Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest.Token with
Ninlil.Web.Models.ConfirmPasswordResetRequest.UserId is its only proof of authorization.

name.description: A human-readable name describing what the token is used for.

oneTime.description:
Whether the token is consumed the first time it is used
(Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ApiTokenTypeEnum.OneTime) rather than working until it is revoked or
expires (Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ApiTokenTypeEnum.Static).

expiresAtUtc.description:
The UTC date and time the token stops being valid, or null for a token
that never expires.

CreateApiTokenRequest.description: This class carries the settings for a new API token, sent to `POST /api/api-tokens`.

rawToken.description: The raw, secret token value, shown once at issuance.

CreateApiTokenResponse.description:
This class carries a newly issued API token with its raw secret value. This response is the
only place the raw value ever appears; listings show only Ninlil.Web.Models.ApiTokenSummary.

name.description: The role's display name.

description.description: A short, human-readable explanation of what the role is for.

CreateRoleRequest.description: This class carries the settings for a new role (`POST /api/roles`).

email.description: The account's e-mail address, if any.

displayName.description: The account's friendly display name, if any.

CreateUserRequest.description: This class carries the settings for a new user account (`POST /api/users`).

serverIdentifierAddress.description:
The IPv4 address the server identifies itself as, or null to detect it
at startup.

offerHoldDuration.description: How long an offered address is held for the client before it is reclaimed. Defaults to 30 seconds.

declinedAddressQuarantineDuration.description: How long an address a client declined is kept out of use. Defaults to 10 minutes.

DhcpCoreSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of part of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Core.DhcpServerOptions`,
the settings shared by the local DHCP engines (`GET /api/dhcp-settings/core`).

DhcpLeaseDetail.description:
This class carries one DHCP lease, as returned by the list and get endpoints of
`/api/dhcp-leases`. There is no write request: the allocation engine creates and
updates leases as clients come and go, and an operator can only release one
(`POST /api/dhcp-leases/{id}/release`). Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpLeaseDetail.PrefixLength is set only for a
DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation lease and is null for an address lease (see
`LeaseEntity.PrefixLength`).

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DhcpLeaseDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: A short, human-readable name for the option.

description.description: A longer description of what the option carries and which RFC section defines it.

isServerAddressEligible.description:
Whether the UI should offer "use this server's address" as an alternative to typing a
value.

DhcpOptionCatalogEntryDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of one Ninlil.Dhcp.Common.OptionCatalog.DhcpOptionCatalogEntry, as returned by
`GET /api/dhcp-option-catalog`. It copies the catalog record field by field so the API
does not change when the record does (see
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.DhcpOptionCatalogController).

enable.description: Whether the listener starts at boot and answers DHCPv4 traffic. Defaults to false.

serverPort.description: The port the listener binds to. Defaults to 67.

clientPort.description: The port a reply sent directly to a client goes to. Defaults to 68.

DhcpProtocolSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Protocol.Dhcpv4.Dhcpv4ProtocolOptions`,
the DHCPv4 UDP listener's settings (`GET /api/dhcp-settings/protocol`).

interfaceName.description: The OS-reported network interface name this override applies to (for example `eth0`), matched case-insensitively.

exclude.description: When true, no Router Advertisements are sent on this interface and every other field is ignored.

managedAddressConfiguration.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.ManagedAddressConfiguration for this interface, or inherits it when null.

otherConfiguration.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.OtherConfiguration for this interface, or inherits it when null.

routerLifetime.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.RouterLifetime for this interface, or inherits it when null.

currentHopLimit.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.CurrentHopLimit for this interface, or inherits it when null.

reachableTime.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.ReachableTime for this interface, or inherits it when null.

retransTimer.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.RetransTimer for this interface, or inherits it when null.

linkMtu.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.LinkMtu for this interface, or inherits it when null.

recursiveDnsServers.description: Wholesale-replaces Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.RecursiveDnsServers for this interface when non-null, or inherits the global list when null.

recursiveDnsServerLifetime.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.RecursiveDnsServerLifetime for this interface, or inherits it when null.

dnsSearchListDomains.description: Wholesale-replaces Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.DnsSearchListDomains for this interface when non-null, or inherits the global list when null.

dnsSearchListLifetime.description: Overrides Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.DnsSearchListLifetime for this interface, or inherits it when null.

DhcpRaInterfaceOverrideDetail.description: This record is the REST shape of one `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Ra.RaInterfaceOverrideOptions` entry: different Router Advertisement content for one network interface. It appears in Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.InterfaceOverrides and in the `interfaceOverrides` array of `PATCH /api/dhcp-settings/ra`. A null scalar field inherits the matching global field. A nullNinlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaInterfaceOverrideDetail.RecursiveDnsServers or Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaInterfaceOverrideDetail.DnsSearchListDomains inherits the global list; any other value, even an empty list, replaces it. `RaInterfaceOverrideOptions` has the full rules. The override's `Prefixes` and `Routes` lists are not included. Prefixes are file-only globally too (see Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail), and a route list nested inside this list would make the API and UI much more complex. Both can be set in the JSON configuration file (`RaInterfaceOverrideOptions.Prefixes` and `.Routes`).

enable.description: Whether the listener starts at boot, sending and answering Router Advertisement traffic. Defaults to false.

minRouterAdvertisementInterval.description: The shortest interval between two unsolicited advertisements on one interface. Defaults to 198 seconds.

maxRouterAdvertisementInterval.description: The longest interval between two unsolicited advertisements on one interface. Defaults to 600 seconds.

DhcpRaProtocolSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Protocol.Ra.RaProtocolOptions`
(`GET /api/dhcp-settings/ra-protocol`): whether the Router Advertisement listener runs
and how often it sends unsolicited advertisements. What an advertisement contains is in
Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail, following the same split in the options classes.

prefix.description: The route's prefix, or null or empty when PrefixLength is `0` (an entry that only sets the default route's preference).

prefixLength.description: The number of significant leading bits of Prefix, 0 to 128. Defaults to 64.

routeLifetime.description: How long the route stays valid, counted from each advertisement that carries it. Defaults to 1800 seconds.

DhcpRaRouteDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of one `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Ra.RaAdvertisedRouteOptions`
entry: a route advertised in an RFC 4191 Section 2.3 Route Information option. It appears
in Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.Routes and in the `routes` array of
`PATCH /api/dhcp-settings/ra`.

managedAddressConfiguration.description: The RFC 4861 "M" flag: hosts should get addresses from stateful DHCPv6. Defaults to false.

otherConfiguration.description: The RFC 4861 "O" flag: hosts should use DHCPv6 for configuration other than addresses. Defaults to false.

routerLifetime.description: How long a host may use this server as a default router; zero (the default) means not at all.

currentHopLimit.description: The hop limit recommended for outgoing unicast packets; zero means no recommendation. Defaults to 64.

reachableTime.description: How long a neighbor is assumed reachable after confirmation; zero (the default) means no recommendation.

retransTimer.description: How long a host waits before sending a Neighbor Solicitation again; zero (the default) means no recommendation.

linkMtu.description: The link MTU to advertise, or null (the default) to send no MTU option.

recursiveDnsServers.description: The Recursive DNS Server addresses (RFC 8106 Section 5.1) advertised to SLAAC hosts.

recursiveDnsServerLifetime.description: How long a host may use RecursiveDnsServers. Defaults to 1800 seconds.

dnsSearchListDomains.description: The DNS Search List domains (RFC 8106 Section 5.2) advertised to SLAAC hosts.

dnsSearchListLifetime.description: How long a host may use DnsSearchListDomains. Defaults to 1800 seconds.

routes.description: The specific routes advertised in RFC 4191 Section 2.3 Route Information options.

interfaceOverrides.description:
Per-interface content overrides. Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaInterfaceOverrideDetail explains how
a null field inherits the value above, and why its prefix and route
lists are not exposed here.

DhcpRaSettingsDetail.description: This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Ra.RaOptions` (`GET /api/dhcp-settings/ra`): what the server's Router Advertisements contain. The transport and timing settings are in Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaProtocolSettingsDetail. `RaOptions.Prefixes` is not included. Each advertised prefix has its own on-link and autonomous flags and two lifetimes, which suits a separate sub-resource (as `DhcpReservationsController` gives reservations) better than a field here. Prefixes are configured in the configuration file only. Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.Routes is included. An RFC 4191 route is a simple triple (prefix and length, preference, lifetime), so a `PATCH` replaces the whole list, as it does Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.RecursiveDnsServers and Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRaSettingsDetail.DnsSearchListDomains. `RaOptions` lives in the JSON configuration file, not the database, so its list entries have no stable identifiers to build a sub-resource on. Every change needs a restart.

enable.description: Whether the server acts as a DHCPv4 relay agent. Defaults to false.

upstreamServerAddresses.description: The IPv4 addresses of the upstream DHCPv4 servers requests are forwarded to.

upstreamServerPort.description: The UDP port the upstream servers listen on. Defaults to 67.

relayAgentAddress.description:
The IPv4 address the relay puts in `giaddr`, or null to detect it
at startup.

relayAgentCircuitId.description: The Agent Circuit ID text added to every forwarded request, or null for none. Printable ASCII, at most 253 characters, and at most 251 together with the Remote ID.

relayAgentRemoteId.description: The Agent Remote ID text added to every forwarded request, or null for none. Printable ASCII, at most 253 characters, and at most 251 together with the Circuit ID.

DhcpRelaySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Relay.Dhcpv4RelayOptions`
(`GET /api/dhcp-settings/relay`): whether the server relays DHCPv4 requests to
upstream servers instead of answering them from its own scopes.

DhcpReservationDetail.description:
This class carries a DHCP reservation, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints
under `/api/dhcp-scopes/{scopeId}/reservations`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and

clientIdentifier.description: The client's identifier: a MAC address for DHCPv4, or a DUID for DHCPv6.

ipAddress.description: The fixed IP address reserved for the client.

hostName.description: An operator-supplied host name for the reservation, or null for none.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the reservation.

DhcpReservationWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a static reservation
in a DHCP scope (`POST` and `PUT` under `/api/dhcp-scopes/{scopeId}/reservations`).

DhcpScopeCustomOptionDetail.description:
This class carries a scope's custom option, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints under `/api/dhcp-scopes/{scopeId}/custom-options`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.
