DhcpScopeCustomOptionDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

optionTag.description:
The option's numeric tag. Use 1 to 254, except 52 (Option Overload), 53 (DHCP Message Type)
and 82 (Relay Agent Information), which the server or relay agent sets itself. 0 (Pad) and
255 (End) are reserved markers. The value is at most 255 bytes.

valueHex.description:
The option's raw value bytes as a hexadecimal string with an even number of digits; it is
stored in uppercase. It is not used, and may be blank, when
ValueSource is Ninlil.Dhcp.Common.Enum.DhcpOptionValueSourceEnum.ServerAddress.

isDisabled.description: Whether the custom option is disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the custom option.

DhcpScopeCustomOptionWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a custom, raw DHCPv4 option
in a scope (`POST` and `PUT` under `/api/dhcp-scopes/{scopeId}/custom-options`).

DhcpScopeDetail.description:
This class carries a DHCP scope, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints of
`/api/dhcp-scopes`. The fields mean what they mean in
Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpScopeWriteRequest.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DhcpScopeDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

scopeId.description: The identifier of the scope the figures describe.

scopeName.description: The name of the scope the figures describe.

totalSlots.description:
How many slots the scope's range holds, as a decimal string. A slot is an address for an
Ninlil.Dhcp.Data.Abstractions.Enum.DhcpScopeKindEnum.AddressAssignment scope, or a block-aligned delegable
prefix for a Ninlil.Dhcp.Data.Abstractions.Enum.DhcpScopeKindEnum.PrefixDelegation scope.

leasedCount.description: How many slots are actively leased.

offeredCount.description: How many slots are offered and awaiting the client's request.

reservedCount.description: How many enabled static reservations the scope has.

availableSlots.description:
TotalSlots minus every distinct slot held by a blocking lease or an
                enabled reservation, as a decimal string; never negative.

DhcpScopeStatisticsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Core.Statistics.DhcpScopeStatistics`,
one scope's utilization (`GET /api/dhcp-scopes/{id}/statistics`). The figures are
computed on each request, not cached; that class documents how. Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpScopeStatisticsDetail.TotalSlots
and Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpScopeStatisticsDetail.AvailableSlots are decimal strings rather than JSON numbers because an
IPv6 range can hold far more addresses than a JSON number represents exactly (a
`/64` holds 2^64).

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the scope.

rangeStartAddress.description: The first address of the pool the scope leases from, inclusive.

rangeEndAddress.description: The last address of the pool the scope leases from, inclusive.

subnetPrefixLength.description: The prefix length, in bits, of the network the range belongs to.

defaultLeaseDuration.description: The lease duration granted to a client that does not ask for one.

maxLeaseDuration.description: The longest lease duration the scope grants.

gatewayAddresses.description: The router (default gateway) addresses the scope hands out, in order of preference.

dnsServerAddresses.description: The DNS server addresses the scope hands out, in order of preference.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the scope.

dnsZoneId.description:
The DNS zone in which a lease from this scope registers an A or AAAA record for the
client's host name, or null to turn off DHCP-to-DNS registration for
the scope.

bootFileName.description:
The boot file a PXE client leasing from this scope should request, or
null to offer none (see `DhcpScopeEntity.BootFileName`).

nextServerAddress.description:
The TFTP (or other boot) server a PXE client should contact for
BootFileName, or null to use this server's Server
Identifier address (see `DhcpScopeEntity.NextServerAddress`).

delegatedPrefixLength.description:
The length, in bits, of each prefix the scope delegates. Required when
Kind is Ninlil.Dhcp.Data.Abstractions.Enum.DhcpScopeKindEnum.PrefixDelegation, and must be
null otherwise (see `DhcpScopeEntity.DelegatedPrefixLength`).

DhcpScopeWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a DHCP scope
(`POST /api/dhcp-scopes`, `PUT /api/dhcp-scopes/{id}`).

DhcpServiceKindEnum.description:
This enumeration names the four DHCP-family services that
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.DhcpServiceControlController reports on and controls, one per
registered `Ninlil.Dhcp.Common.Control.IDhcpProtocolService` implementation. The
`{kind}` route segment of M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.DhcpServiceControlController.Start(Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpServiceKindEnum,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
and M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.DhcpServiceControlController.Stop(Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpServiceKindEnum,System.Threading.CancellationToken) binds to it
case-insensitively (the ASP.NET Core default for an enum), so an unknown segment fails model
binding before the action runs.

enabled.description:
Whether the service's `Enable` option says it starts at boot. It is read from the
settings loaded at startup, so a saved change shows only after a restart.

isRunning.description: Whether the service's listener is bound and serving traffic now.

DhcpServiceStatus.description:
This record is one DHCP-family service's state, as returned by
`/api/dhcp-services`: its configured Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpServiceStatus.Enabled flag (whether it starts at
boot) and whether it Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpServiceStatus.IsRunning. The two can differ either way. A service
configured off can be running because it was started through this controller, and one
configured on can be stopped, either through this controller or, for
Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpServiceKindEnum.Tftp only, because it declined to bind (for example when
its root directory is missing; see `TftpServer`).
`Ninlil.Dhcp.Common.Control.IDhcpProtocolService` explains the distinction.

DhcpTagRuleDetail.description:
This class carries a tag rule, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints of
`/api/dhcp-tag-rules`.

DhcpTagRuleOptionDetail.description:
This class carries one option of a tag rule, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints under `/api/dhcp-tag-rules/{tagRuleId}/options`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

DhcpTagRuleOptionDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

optionTag.description:
The option's numeric tag, as in Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpScopeCustomOptionWriteRequest.OptionTag.
Those limits apply to a global rule and to a rule for a DHCPv4 scope. A rule for a DHCPv6
scope only rejects tag 0 and values over 65 535 bytes.

valueHex.description:
The option's raw value bytes as hexadecimal, as in
Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpScopeCustomOptionWriteRequest.ValueHex. It is not used, and may be
blank, when ValueSource is
Ninlil.Dhcp.Common.Enum.DhcpOptionValueSourceEnum.ServerAddress.

DhcpTagRuleOptionWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace an option a tag rule
contributes (`POST` and `PUT` under `/api/dhcp-tag-rules/{tagRuleId}/options`).

name.description: An operator-chosen, descriptive name for the rule.

scopeId.description: The one scope the rule applies to, or null for clients of any scope.

priority.description: The rule's evaluation order, ascending; a later rule's option overrides an earlier one's. Defaults to 0.

vendorClassIdentifierMatch.description: The Vendor Class Identifier value the rule matches, or null.

userClassMatch.description: The User Class value the rule matches, or null.

relayAgentCircuitIdHex.description: The Agent Circuit ID the rule requires, as hex, or null (DHCPv4 only).

relayAgentRemoteIdHex.description: The relay agent (DHCPv4) or DHCPv6 Remote ID the rule requires, as hex, or null.

relayInterfaceIdHex.description: The DHCPv6 Interface-ID the rule requires, as hex, or null (DHCPv6 only).

vendorClassEnterpriseNumber.description: The IANA Enterprise Number a DHCPv6 Vendor Class option must carry, or null (DHCPv6 only).

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the rule.

DhcpTagRuleWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a tag-based conditional
option delivery rule (`POST /api/dhcp-tag-rules`, `PUT /api/dhcp-tag-rules/{id}`).
`Ninlil.Dhcp.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DhcpTagRuleEntity` documents how rules match,
the order they apply in and how conflicts resolve. Every match field is optional; the set
ones must all match.

enable.description: Whether the TFTP server starts at boot. Defaults to false.

port.description: The UDP port the TFTP server listens on. Defaults to 69.

rootDirectory.description: The directory files are served from. Empty by default.

retransmitTimeoutSeconds.description: How long, in seconds, to wait for an acknowledgment before sending a block again. Defaults to 2.

maxRetransmissions.description: How many times one block is sent again before the transfer is abandoned. Defaults to 5.

maxConcurrentTransfers.description: How many transfers may run at once, at most 4 per client address. A request over the limit is dropped without a reply. At least 1. Defaults to 50.

DhcpTftpSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Tftp.TftpServerOptions`, the
bundled read-only RFC 1350 TFTP server (`GET /api/dhcp-settings/tftp`).

enable.description: Whether the listener starts at boot and answers DHCPv6 traffic. Defaults to false.

serverPort.description: The port the listener binds to. Defaults to 547, the IANA DHCPv6 server port.

clientPort.description: The port a reply is unicast to. Defaults to 546, the IANA DHCPv6 client port.

Dhcpv6ProtocolSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Protocol.Dhcpv6.Dhcpv6ProtocolOptions`,
the DHCPv6 UDP listener's settings (`GET /api/dhcp-settings/dhcpv6-protocol`); the
DHCPv6 counterpart of Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpProtocolSettingsDetail.

enable.description: Whether the server acts as a DHCPv6 relay agent. Defaults to false.

upstreamServerAddresses.description: The IPv6 addresses of the upstream DHCPv6 servers RELAY-FORW messages are sent to.

upstreamServerPort.description: The UDP port the upstream servers listen on. Defaults to 547.

relayLinkAddress.description:
The IPv6 address the relay puts in the RELAY-FORW "link-address" field, or
null to detect it at startup.

interfaceId.description: The RFC 8415 Section 21.18 Interface-ID text added to every RELAY-FORW, or null for none.

Dhcpv6RelaySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dhcp.Server.Relay.Dhcpv6RelayOptions`
(`GET /api/dhcp-settings/dhcpv6-relay`): whether the server acts as an RFC 8415
DHCPv6 relay agent instead of answering from its own scopes. It is the DHCPv6 counterpart
of Ninlil.Web.Models.DhcpRelaySettingsDetail.

enable.description: Whether AAAA records are synthesized for IPv4-only names. Defaults to false.

synthesisPrefix.description: The IPv6 prefix synthesized addresses are built in. Defaults to the well-known `64:ff9b::/96`.

Dns64SettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the DNS64 settings (`Dns64Options`) that
`GET /api/dns64-settings` returns. Nothing in it is secret, so a `PATCH` to the
same endpoint accepts the same fields.

name.description: The rule's human-readable name.

cidr.description: The rule's network in CIDR notation, as stored.

capabilities.description:
The capabilities the rule grants, as an array of
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsAccessControlCapabilityEnum member names (see
Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsAccessControlRuleWriteRequest.Capabilities).

isDisabled.description:
Whether the rule is disabled. The enforcement engine ignores a disabled rule (see
Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsAccessControlRuleEntity.IsDisabled).

updatedAtUtc.description: When the rule was last modified, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the rule was last created or modified on, used by cluster config sync,
or null if it was never written with clustering enabled.

DnsAccessControlRuleDetail.description:
This class carries an access-control rule, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints of `/api/access-control-rules`. Nothing in it is secret, so there is no
reveal-once handling as with `TsigKeyDetail` or `CloudProviderCredentialDetail`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DnsAccessControlRuleDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable name for the rule (for example, "Trusted LAN").

cidr.description:
The network the rule applies to, in CIDR notation with a prefix length (a bare address is
rejected; write `/32` or `/128` for one host). It must parse with
M:System.Net.IPNetwork.TryParse(System.String,System.Net.IPNetwork@), the parser
`DnsAccessControlRuleCache` matches with at query time.

capabilities.description:
The capabilities the rule grants a client whose source address is in Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsAccessControlRuleWriteRequest.Cidr,
as an array of Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsAccessControlCapabilityEnum member names (for example
`["RecursionAccess", "RateLimitBypass"]`), not the stored
System.FlagsAttribute bitmask. Names are case-sensitive. An empty array is
accepted (a rule that grants nothing); an unknown name is rejected with a 400.

DnsAccessControlRuleWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace an access-control rule for a
network (`POST /api/access-control-rules`, `PUT /api/access-control-rules/{id}`).

name.description: The cache's short name, which the flush and remove actions take as `cache` to act on it alone.

entryCount.description: How many entries it holds right now, including expired ones kept for serve-stale.

maxEntries.description: The configured size bound it is trimmed back to.

hits.description: Lookups that found a fresh entry since startup or the last flush.

misses.description: Lookups that found nothing fresh over the same period.

DnsCacheDetail.description:
This record describes one in-memory DNS answer cache on this node, as returned by
`GET /api/dns-cache`: the forwarded-response cache (`forwarded`), the recursive
resolver's cache (`recursive`) or the DNSSEC trust cache (`dnssec`, the zones
proven secure or insecure, with their keys). The counts are this node's only; caches are
not shared across a cluster.

removedEntryCount.description: How many cache entries were removed, across every cache acted on.

DnsCacheRemovalResult.description:
This record reports what a flush (`DELETE /api/dns-cache`) or a single-name removal
(`DELETE /api/dns-cache/entries/{name}`) did.

cidr.description: The mapping's source address or network, as stored.

clientIdentifier.description: The persistent client identifier the mapping resolves to.

isDisabled.description:
Whether the mapping is disabled. `StaticAddressMappingClientIdentityResolver` ignores
a disabled mapping.

comments.description: Free-text operator notes about the mapping.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the mapping was last modified, or null if never.

DnsClientStaticAddressMappingDetail.description:
This class carries a static address mapping, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints of `/api/client-static-address-mappings`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DnsClientStaticAddressMappingDetailPaged.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

cidr.description:
The source address or network mapped to ClientIdentifier: a bare IP
address (exact match) or a CIDR network with a `/` (matches every address in it). A
value with a `/` must parse with
M:System.Net.IPNetwork.TryParse(System.String,System.Net.IPNetwork@) and one
without with M:System.Net.IPAddress.TryParse(System.String,System.Net.IPAddress@),
the same two forms
`Ninlil.Dns.Server.ClientIdentity.StaticAddressMappingClientIdentityResolver` matches
at query time.

clientIdentifier.description:
The persistent client identifier a query from Cidr resolves to: a
colon-separated MAC address for an Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.InternetProtocolVersionEnum.IPv4 mapping,
or a DHCP Unique Identifier (DUID) for an Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.InternetProtocolVersionEnum.IPv6
one.

comments.description: Free-text operator notes about the mapping.

DnsClientStaticAddressMappingWriteReques.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a manual mapping from a
source address to a client identity (`POST /api/client-static-address-mappings`,
`PUT /api/client-static-address-mappings/{id}`).

enable.description: Whether the server sends and checks DNS Cookies. Defaults to true.

require.description: Whether a query without a valid server cookie is rejected instead of answered. Defaults to false.

secretRotationInterval.description: How often the server cookie secret is replaced. Defaults to 24 hours.

lastModifiedUtc.description: When the settings were last written, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description: The cluster node the last write came from, or null if never written.

DnsCookieSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the RFC 7873 DNS Cookie settings
(`DnsCookieOptions`) that `GET /api/dns-cookie-settings` returns. A `PATCH`
to the same endpoint accepts Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsCookieSettingsDetail.Enable, Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsCookieSettingsDetail.Require and
Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsCookieSettingsDetail.SecretRotationInterval; the last two fields are read-only cluster sync
bookkeeping.

enable.description:
Whether the transport listens. A change applies at once: it starts or stops the
`dnscrypt-udp` and `dnscrypt-tcp` listeners and the
`dnscrypt-certificate-rotation` loop through
Ninlil.Web.Services.IManagedServiceRegistry. The loop issues the resolver's
certificates; without one, a listener could accept connections but not answer an
encrypted query.

port.description: The port the transport binds to, for UDP and TCP. A change needs a listener restart.

listenAddresses.description:
The local IP addresses the transport binds to, for UDP and TCP, one socket per address. An
empty list (the default) means every address, through one dual-stack socket. A change
needs a listener restart.

providerName.description: The provider name certificates are published under (clients query the TXT record `2.dnscrypt-cert.<ProviderName>`). Empty by default, and the listeners refuse to start while it is empty. A change needs a listener restart.

tcpIdleTimeout.description: How long a TCP connection may stay idle before the server closes it. A change needs a listener restart.

maxConcurrentTcpConnections.description: How many TCP connections the server accepts at once. A change needs a listener restart.

enabledEsVersions.description:
The DNSCrypt ciphers the resolver keeps a valid certificate for, by name (for example
`["XChaCha20Poly1305", "XSalsa20Poly1305"]`). `DnsCryptCertificateRotationService`
reads it when it starts, so a change applies once that loop restarts, for example by
turning the transport off and on.

certificateRotationInterval.description: How often a new certificate is considered for each enabled cipher. A change needs a restart of the rotation loop.

certificateValidityDuration.description: How long a new certificate stays valid. A change needs a restart of the rotation loop.

certificateClockSkewTolerance.description: How far a new certificate's validity start is backdated, to allow for client clock skew. A change needs a restart of the rotation loop.

DnsCryptSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the DNSCrypt settings (`DnsCryptOptions`) that
`GET /api/transport-settings/dnscrypt` returns.

enable.description:
Whether a request on the DNS-over-HTTPS route is answered. A change applies at once: it
opens or closes the `dns-over-https` transport gate through
Ninlil.Web.Services.IManagedServiceRegistry. The route is mapped whatever this flag was
at startup (see the extension method above).

path.description:
The HTTP path the GET and POST forms of a DoH query are answered at. A change needs a
process restart, not just a listener restart: routes cannot be remapped once the host has
started.

maxMessageSizeBytes.description:
The largest DNS message the transport accepts. Like Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsOverHttpsSettingsDetail.Path, it is captured
when the route is mapped at startup, so a change needs a process restart.

DnsOverHttpsSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the DNS-over-HTTPS settings (`DnsOverHttpsOptions`) that
`GET /api/transport-settings/dns-over-https` returns, limited to the fields the server
uses. M:Ninlil.Dns.Protocol.DnsOverHttps.Extension.EndpointRouteBuilderDnsOverHttpsExtension.MapNinlilDnsOverHttps(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder)
maps the RFC 8484 GET and POST forms onto the shared Kestrel listener, so the shared web
listener's port, certificate and addresses (`DnsServer:Web`) apply. `Port` and
`Certificate` belong to the self-hosted `DnsOverHttpsHostedService`, which this
server never starts, so they are left out rather than shown as if they had an effect; for
the same reason there is no `ListenAddresses`.

enable.description:
Whether the transport listens. A change applies at once: it starts or stops the
`dns-over-quic` listener through Ninlil.Web.Services.IManagedServiceRegistry.

port.description: The port the transport binds to. A change needs a listener restart.

listenAddresses.description:
The local IP addresses the transport binds to, one socket per address. An empty list (the
default) means every address, through one dual-stack socket. A change needs a listener
restart. QUIC answers only on these addresses, but its library still reserves the UDP port
on every address, and `::` also answers IPv4 (see
`DnsOverQuicOptions.ListenAddresses`).

idleTimeout.description: How long a QUIC connection may stay idle before the server closes it. A change needs a listener restart.

maxConcurrentBidirectionalStreams.description: How many bidirectional streams one QUIC connection may have open at once. A change needs a listener restart.

maxConcurrentConnections.description:
How many QUIC connections the transport serves at once. A connection over the limit is closed
with the DNS-over-QUIC error code `DOQ_EXCESSIVE_LOAD`. Must be at least 1. A change
needs a listener restart.

DnsOverQuicSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the DNS-over-QUIC settings (`DnsOverQuicOptions`) that
`GET /api/transport-settings/dns-over-quic` returns.

enable.description: Whether a connection from a trusted source is checked for a PROXY protocol header.

knownProxies.description: The individual IP addresses allowed to send a PROXY protocol header.

knownNetworks.description: The CIDR networks allowed to send a PROXY protocol header.

DnsOverTlsProxyProtocolSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of `Ninlil.Dns.Protocol.DnsOverTls.ProxyProtocol.ProxyProtocolOptions`:
whether `DnsOverTlsListener` accepts an HAProxy PROXY protocol header (v1 text or v2
binary) before the TLS handshake, and which addresses and networks may send one. Unlike the
HTTP settings above it has no shared secret; `ProxyProtocolOptions` explains why.

enable.description:
Whether the transport listens. A change applies at once:
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.TransportSettingsController.PatchDnsOverTls(System.Text.Json.JsonElement,System.Threading.CancellationToken) starts or stops the
`dns-over-tls` listener through Ninlil.Web.Services.IManagedServiceRegistry.

port.description: The port the transport binds to. A change needs a listener restart.

listenAddresses.description:
The local IP addresses the transport binds to, one socket per address. An empty list (the
default) means every address, through one dual-stack socket. A change needs a listener
restart.

idleTimeout.description: How long a TLS connection may stay idle before the server closes it. A change needs a listener restart.

maxConcurrentConnections.description: How many TLS connections the server accepts at once. A change needs a listener restart.

DnsOverTlsSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the DNS-over-TLS settings (`DnsOverTlsOptions`) that
`GET /api/transport-settings/dns-over-tls` returns. `ProxyProtocol` is left out:
it is exposed once, as the `dnsOverTls` field of
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.ReverseProxySettingsController, next to the HTTP reverse proxy
trust settings it belongs with.

workerCount.description: How many tasks take queries off the queue. Defaults to the processor count.

maxConcurrentQueries.description: How many queries are answered at once. Defaults to 1000.

channelCapacity.description: How many received queries may wait in the queue for a worker. Defaults to 4096.

maxUdpPayloadSizeOctets.description: The largest UDP response sent, in octets. Defaults to 1232.

maxUdpAmplificationFactor.description: The largest allowed ratio of UDP response size to query size. Defaults to 20.

minUdpAmplificationFloorSizeOctets.description: The lowest the amplification cap can drop to, in octets. Defaults to 512, the RFC 1035 UDP limit.

DnsPipelineSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the query pipeline settings
(`DnsQueryProcessingPipelineOptions`) that `GET /api/dns-pipeline-settings`
returns: queue readers, concurrency cap and queue sizing, and the UDP amplification guard. A `PATCH` to
the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

occurredAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time the query was answered.

clientAddress.description: The client's source address, or null if it was not known or not kept.

queriedName.description: The queried name in presentation form, or null if the query had no question.

answerCount.description: How many records the answer section held.

clientIdentifier.description:
The client's persistent identifier (a MAC address or DUID), resolved when the entry was
written, or null when it was not resolved or the privacy level hides it
(see Ninlil.Dns.Server.QueryLog.DnsQueryLogSubscriber).

DnsQueryLogEntryDetail.description:
This class carries one query log entry, as returned in the pages of
`GET /api/query-log`. Nothing in it is secret, so every field is visible to any caller
holding `querylog:read`. What an entry contains depends on the privacy level in force
when it was written.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DnsQueryLogEntryDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

domain.description: The rewrite's domain pattern, as stored.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the rewrite.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the rewrite was last modified, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the rewrite was last created or modified on, used by cluster config sync,
or null if it was never written with clustering enabled.

clientId.description:
The one known client (`Ninlil.Dns.Data.Abstractions.Entity.DnsClientEntity`) the
rewrite applies to, or null if it is global or scoped to a client
group. It is read-only here: this controller never sets it; only
`SafeSearchController.Enable` with a target does. It is shown so the Rewrites page can
tell a targeted Safe Search row from a global one that would otherwise look like a
duplicate.

clientGroupId.description:
The one client group the rewrite applies to, or null if it is global or
scoped to a client. Read-only, like Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsRewriteDetail.ClientId.

DnsRewriteDetail.description:
This class carries a DNS rewrite, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints of
`/api/dns-rewrites`. Nothing in it is secret, so there is no reveal-once handling as
with `TsigKeyDetail` or `WebhookSubscriptionDetail`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DnsRewriteDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

domain.description:
The queried domain the rewrite matches: an exact name, or a wildcard such as
`*.example.com`. It must be a valid domain name.

target.description:
An IP address (answered as an A or AAAA record) or another domain name (answered as a
CNAME). It is checked with `DnsRewriteTargetClassifier.TryClassify`, the classifier
used at query time, much as Ninlil.Web.Controllers.RecordsController checks a record's
`data` with the record codec.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the rewrite.

DnsRewriteWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a DNS rewrite
(`POST /api/dns-rewrites`, `PUT /api/dns-rewrites/{id}`).

keySizeBits.description:
The key size to generate, in bits. Used only by the RSA algorithms, where 0 (the default)
means 2048; ignored by every other algorithm.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

DnssecKeyCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to generate a new DNSSEC key for a zone
(`POST /api/zones/{zoneId}/dnssec-keys`). The key pair is always generated on the
server; an externally generated private key cannot be imported.

zoneId.description: The identifier of the zone the key belongs to.

publicKeyWireFormat.description: The key's public key material, base64-encoded.

keyTag.description: The key's precomputed key tag (RFC 4034 Appendix B).

isRetired.description:
Whether the key has been withdrawn from the zone's DNSKEY RRset: true
when Ninlil.Web.Models.DnssecKeyDetail.LifecycleState is `Removed`. It is the field
Ninlil.Web.Models.DnssecKeyWriteRequest.IsRetired writes.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the key was last updated, or null if never.

publishedAtUtc.description: When the key was first published in the zone's DNSKEY RRset.

retiredAtUtc.description:
When the key last stopped being the zone's signing key for its role, or
null if it never has.

parentDsConfirmedAtUtc.description:
When an operator confirmed that a KSK rollover's new DS record is published at an
externally hosted parent zone, or null if no confirmation is recorded
(no rollover needs one, or it is still awaited).

dnsKeyRecord.description: The key's DNSKEY record in presentation format, as published in the zone.

dsRecord.description:
The SHA-256 DS record a parent zone publishes for this key, in presentation format, or
null for a ZSK, which the parent never references.

dsDigest.description:
The digest part of DsRecord on its own, as uppercase hexadecimal, for
registrars that ask for the key tag, algorithm, digest type and digest separately.

DnssecKeyDetail.description:
This class carries a DNSSEC key, as returned by the list, get and create endpoints under
`/api/zones/{zoneId}/dnssec-keys`. It never includes the private key. Unlike a TSIG
secret or a cloud provider credential, a DNSSEC private key never needs to leave the
server: it is used only for signing inside `Server.Authoritative`, stays encrypted at
rest and is never exposed over REST.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

DnssecKeyDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

keySizeBits.description:
The new key's size, in bits. Used only by the RSA algorithms, where 0 (the default) means
2048.

DnssecKeyRolloverRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to start an automated RFC 6781 key rollover for an
active key (`POST /api/zones/{zoneId}/dnssec-keys/{id}/roll`). The scheme follows from
the key's `Role`: Pre-Publish (RFC 6781 §4.1.1.1) for a ZSK and Double-Signature
(RFC 6781 §4.1.2) for a KSK. The other scheme cannot be requested.

propagationDelay.description: The assumed time for a zone change to reach all of the zone's authoritative servers, added to each rollover wait. Defaults to 1 hour.

externalParentDsTtl.description: The assumed TTL of the DS record at a parent zone this server does not host, used in KSK rollovers. Defaults to 1 day.

pollInterval.description: How often the background service checks for a rollover step that is due. Defaults to 15 minutes.

DnssecKeyRolloverSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the key rollover timing (`DnssecKeyRolloverOptions`)
that `GET /api/dnssec-key-rollover-settings` returns. `DnssecKeyRolloverBackgroundService`
uses it to step the keys of every locally signed zone through the RFC 6781 §4.1.1.1 and
§4.1.2 rollovers. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

isRetired.description:
true moves the key to the `Removed` lifecycle state, out of the
                zone; false (the default) moves it to `Active`, whatever state it
                was in, which also cancels a rollover in progress.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

DnssecKeyWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the editable state of a DNSSEC key, replaced in full by
`PUT /api/zones/{zoneId}/dnssec-keys/{id}`. A key's role, algorithm and key material
are fixed once generated; changing them means generating a new key and retiring the old
one. So the retirement flag and notes are the only writable fields.

allowedAlgorithms.description:
The only algorithms a new key may use. An empty list (the default) allows every algorithm
`DnssecAlgorithmRegistry` supports except RSAMD5, DSA, RSASHA1, DSA-NSEC3-SHA1,
RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1 and ECC-GOST, which this server never signs with; a PATCH naming one
of them is rejected with 400. It limits only key generation, not which
algorithms are accepted when validating zones signed elsewhere.

DnssecPolicySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the DNSSEC algorithm policy
(`DnssecAlgorithmPolicyOptions`) that `GET /api/dnssec-policy-settings` returns:
which algorithms `IDnssecKeyManagementService.GenerateKeyAsync` may generate a new key
for. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same field.

isConnected.description:
Whether the active broker transport reports itself connected, or null
when Ninlil.Web.Models.EventBrokerSettingsDetail.Transport is Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.EventTransportEnum.InMemory, where
"connected" has no meaning.

lastModifiedUtc.description:
When the settings were last written through the REST API, used by cluster config sync, or
null if they never have been.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the settings were last written on, or null together
with Ninlil.Web.Models.EventBrokerSettingsDetail.LastModifiedUtc.

EventBrokerSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the event transport configuration that `GET /api/event-broker-settings`
returns. Only the section matching Ninlil.Web.Models.EventBrokerSettingsDetail.Transport is filled in; the other is
null. A broker that was not selected never had its options configured,
so reading them through Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptions`1 would
return compiled-in defaults that look like live configuration.

FilterListDetail.description:
This class carries a block or allow list without its entries, as returned by the list, get
and write endpoints of `/api/filter-lists`. `LastFetchedAtUtc` is when a
subscribed list was last fetched, and `OriginatingNodeId` the cluster node the list
was last written on.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

FilterListDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

FilterListEntryDetail.description:
This class carries one filter list entry, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints
under `/api/filter-lists/{listId}/entries`. `IsException` marks an exception (an adblock-syntax `@@`
rule from a subscribed list) that lets a name through even though another entry in the
same list covers it; only a subscribed list's refresh ever sets it, so it is not part of
Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListEntryWriteRequest.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

FilterListEntryDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

value.description:
The entry's value: a domain name, wildcard or regular expression (by Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListEntryWriteRequest.Kind)
in a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.Domain list, or an IP address or CIDR network in
a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.ResponseIp or
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListKindEnum.ClientSource list, where Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterListEntryWriteRequest.Kind must be
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Domain (the default).

comment.description: Free-form operator notes about the entry.

FilterListEntryWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or replace an entry in a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Local list (`POST` and `PUT` under
`/api/filter-lists/{listId}/entries`). Every write to the entries of a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed list is rejected with 409 (see
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.FilterListEntriesController).

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the list.

subscriptionUrl.description:
The URL a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed list's entries are fetched
from. Required for a subscribed list, otherwise ignored.

refreshInterval.description:
How often a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Subscribed list is fetched again.
Ignored for a Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterListSourceEnum.Local list.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the list.

FilterListWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a block or allow list
(`POST /api/filter-lists`, `PUT /api/filter-lists/{id}`).

FilterPatternPreviewMatch.description: This class carries whether one sample domain matched a previewed pattern.

sampleDomains.description:
The domains to test Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Value against. When omitted or empty, the small built-in
set `FilterPatternPreviewController.DefaultSampleDomains` is used.

FilterPatternPreviewRequest.description:
This class carries a request to preview which sample domains a candidate filter list entry
pattern would match (`POST /api/filter-pattern-preview`). The UI sends it while an
operator types, before anything is saved.

isValid.description:
Whether Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Value compiles as the requested
Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewRequest.Kind, using the same check
`FilterListEntriesController` applies before saving a
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Wildcard or Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.DnsFilterEntryKindEnum.Regex
entry.

error.description: A human-readable reason Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewResult.IsValid is false, or null when it is true.

matches.description:
Each sample domain tested and whether the pattern matched it. Empty when
Ninlil.Web.Models.FilterPatternPreviewResult.IsValid is false, since a pattern that does not compile is
not tested.

FilterPatternPreviewResult.description:
This class carries the result of previewing a candidate filter list entry pattern, the
response of `POST /api/filter-pattern-preview`.

enable.description: Whether block and allow lists are applied at all. Defaults to false.

sinkholeAddressV4.description: The address a blocked A query gets in sinkhole mode. Defaults to `0.0.0.0`.

sinkholeAddressV6.description: The address a blocked AAAA query gets in sinkhole mode. Defaults to `::`.

sinkholeTimeToLiveSeconds.description: The TTL, in seconds, of a synthesized sinkhole record. Defaults to 60.

blockCnameCloaking.description: Whether an answer is also blocked when one of its CNAME targets is blocked. Defaults to true.

FilteringSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the filtering engine settings (`DnsFilterOptions`)
that `GET /api/filtering-settings` returns. Nothing in it is secret, so a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields. The lists themselves are managed
through `/api/filter-lists`.

email.description:
The e-mail address to look up. The response never says whether it matches an account (see
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest)).

ForgotPasswordRequest.description:
This class carries the e-mail address an anonymous, self-service Forgot Password request
submits to M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest).

ForgotPasswordResult.description:
This class carries the response of M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.AuthController.ForgotPassword(Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordRequest).
Ninlil.Web.Models.ForgotPasswordResult.Message is the same whether or not a reset link was sent, so a caller cannot
tell the two apart.

name.description: The forwarder's human-readable name.

definitionString.description: The forwarder's definition string, as stored.

sortOrder.description: The forwarder's position among the global forwarders; lower values are tried first.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the forwarder.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the forwarder was last modified, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the forwarder was last created or modified on, used by cluster config
sync, or null if it was never written with clustering enabled.

ForwarderDetail.description:
This class carries a global upstream forwarder, as returned by the list, get and write
endpoints of `/api/forwarders`. A definition string is not a credential, so there is
no reveal-once handling as with `TsigKeyDetail` or
`CloudProviderCredentialDetail`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ForwarderDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the forwarder.

definitionString.description:
The forwarder definition, in the style Technitium and AdGuard Home use: a bare address; a
`udp://`, `tcp://`, `tls://`, `https://` or `quic://` URL; or an
`sdns://` DNSCrypt stamp. It is checked with `IUpstreamForwarderDefinitionParser`
(and `DnsCryptStampParser` for a stamp) before it is saved, much as
Ninlil.Web.Controllers.RecordsController checks a record's `data`.

sortOrder.description: The forwarder's position among the global forwarders; lower values are tried first. Defaults to 0.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the forwarder.

ForwarderWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create or fully replace a global upstream forwarder
(`POST /api/forwarders`, `PUT /api/forwarders/{id}`).

enable.description: Whether the configured forwarders are used at all. Defaults to false.

healthCheckInterval.description: How often each forwarder's health is probed under health-checked round robin. Defaults to 30 seconds.

perForwarderTimeout.description: How long one forwarder may take to answer before the attempt counts as failed. Defaults to 3 seconds.

enableCache.description: Whether forwarded answers are cached. Defaults to true.

maxCacheEntries.description: How many forwarded answers may be cached before the soonest to expire are evicted. Defaults to 10000.

ForwardingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the forwarding engine settings (`ForwardingOptions`)
that `GET /api/forwarding-settings` returns. Nothing in it is secret, so a
`PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields. The forwarders themselves are a
separate resource (`ForwardersController`); this record holds the on/off switch,
failover and health-check tuning, and the forwarded-answer cache settings that apply to
all of them.

requiredLength.description: The fewest characters a new password may contain.

requiredUniqueChars.description: The fewest distinct characters a new password must contain.

requireDigit.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one digit.

requireLowercase.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one lowercase letter.

requireUppercase.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one uppercase letter.

requireNonAlphanumeric.description: Whether a new password must contain at least one non-alphanumeric character.

defaultLockoutTimeSpan.description: How long an account is locked out once Ninlil.Web.Models.IdentitySettingsDetail.MaxFailedAccessAttempts is reached.

maxFailedAccessAttempts.description: How many consecutive failed sign-in attempts trigger a lockout.

allowedForNewUsers.description: Whether lockout applies to a newly created account too.

IdentitySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the password complexity and account lockout policy that
`GET /api/identity-settings` returns: ASP.NET Core Identity's
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Password and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Lockout. Nothing
in it is secret, so a `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.User, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.SignIn,
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Tokens, Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.ClaimsIdentity and
Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.IdentityOptions.Stores are left out: they are structural choices the
identity wiring depends on (unique e-mail enforcement, for example, which rejects an
account with no e-mail), not policy to tune.

durationMinutes.description:
How many minutes from now to pause for. Zero or a negative number is rejected with a
`400` (Ninlil.Dns.Common.Exceptions.ValidationException).

InstantPauseRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to start an instant pause
(`POST /api/clients/{id}/pause` and `POST /api/client-groups/{id}/pause`). It
takes a duration rather than a timestamp because the UI offers one-click choices such as
"15 minutes" or "1 hour", and a duration needs no reasoning about the caller's time zone or
clock. The server sets `PausedUntilUtc` to its current time plus the duration.

rememberMe.description:
With Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.RefreshTokenDeliveryEnum.Cookie delivery, whether the session should
outlive the browser: a persistent cookie and the long refresh lifetime when
true, otherwise a browser-session cookie and the short browser-session
lifetime. Ignored for Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.RefreshTokenDeliveryEnum.Body delivery, whose sessions
are always long-lived.

LoginRequest.description: This class carries the credentials a caller signs in with.

requiresTwoFactor.description: Whether a second authentication factor is still required.

mfaToken.description:
An opaque, short-lived token identifying this pending sign-in, to be echoed back to
`POST /api/auth/login/two-factor`. Only set when Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor is
true.

accessToken.description: The signed JSON Web Token access token, once sign-in is complete.

expiresAtUtc.description: The UTC date and time Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.AccessToken expires.

refreshToken.description:
The opaque refresh token, once sign-in is complete, or null when it was
delivered as a cookie.

LoginResponse.description:
This class carries the outcome of a sign-in attempt. One of two shapes applies: either Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor is true and
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.MfaToken is set (the caller must next call
`POST /api/auth/login/two-factor`), or a full Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.AccessToken/
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RefreshToken pair is set because sign-in is already complete.

generatedAtUtc.description: When the loaded data was downloaded from the IEEE.

maLEntryCount.description: How many MA-L (24-bit) prefixes are loaded.

maMEntryCount.description: How many MA-M (28-bit) prefixes are loaded.

maSEntryCount.description: How many MA-S (36-bit) prefixes are loaded.

totalEntryCount.description: How many prefixes are loaded across all three registries.

lastRefreshAttemptUtc.description: When a refresh was last attempted, or null if never.

lastRefreshError.description: Why that attempt failed, or null when it did not.

lastSuccessfulCheckUtc.description: When a refresh last completed successfully, or null if never.

nextRefreshDueUtc.description:
When the next automatic refresh is due, or null while automatic refresh
is disabled.

MacVendorDataStatusDetail.description:
This record reports the vendor data answering lookups and its refresh history. It is
returned inside Ninlil.Web.Models.MacVendorSettingsDetail and by an on-demand refresh
(`POST /api/mac-vendor-settings/refresh`).

enableAutomaticRefresh.description: Whether the IEEE registries are downloaded again periodically. Defaults to true.

refreshInterval.description: How long to wait after a successful check before checking again. Defaults to 14 days.

maLRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-L (24-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

maMRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-M (28-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

maSRegistryUrl.description: Where the MA-S (36-bit) registry CSV is downloaded from.

dataFilePath.description: Where refreshed data is persisted (read-only here).

MacVendorSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the MAC vendor lookup settings (`MacVendorLookupOptions`) that
`GET /api/mac-vendor-settings` returns, with a read-only report of the vendor data
loaded. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts every settings field except
DataFilePath, a path read once at startup that, like other state paths,
is set only in the configuration file.

name.description:
The service's stable name, used as `{name}` in `POST /api/services/{name}/start`
and the other control actions.

isRunning.description:
Whether the service is running. For a DNS transport listener this is observed from the
listener; for a maintenance loop with no such signal, it means start was called more
recently than stop (see Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Services.IManagedServiceRegistration.IsRunning).

ManagedServiceSummary.description:
This record describes one Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Services.IManagedServiceRegistration, as listed by
`GET /api/services`: a DNS transport listener or background maintenance loop, and
whether it is running.

maxAttempts.description: How many times one NOTIFY is sent before giving up. Defaults to 5.

responseTimeout.description: How long to wait for a secondary's reply to one attempt. Defaults to 3 seconds.

retryDelay.description: How long to wait between attempts. Defaults to 3 seconds.

secondaryPort.description: The port NOTIFY messages are sent to. Defaults to 53.

NotifySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the NOTIFY settings (`NotifyOptions`) that
`GET /api/notify-settings` returns: how the server sends RFC 1996 NOTIFY messages to a
zone's secondaries. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

enable.description: Whether admin sign-in through OpenID Connect is offered. Defaults to false.

displayName.description: The label of the sign-in button on the admin console's login page. Defaults to "Single Sign-On".

clientId.description: The OAuth 2.0 client identifier this server is registered under.

clientSecretConfigured.description:
Whether a client secret is set from either source: `OidcSsoOptions.ClientSecretEncrypted`
or the plaintext `OidcSsoOptions.ClientSecret`. The secret itself is never returned.

scopes.description: The scopes requested in the authorization code flow. Defaults to `openid`, `profile` and `email`.

clientSecretFromEnvironment.description:
Whether a plaintext client secret is set outside the admin console (the
`NINLIL_IDENTITY_SSO_CLIENT_SECRET` environment variable). It overrides the stored
secret, so a secret saved on this page has no effect while it is set.

clientSecretUnreadable.description:
Whether a stored client secret exists but this server's Data Protection key ring cannot
decrypt it (the key ring changed) and no plaintext secret overrides it. SSO sign-in fails at
the provider until the secret is entered again; the rest of the server is unaffected.

OidcSsoSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the OpenID Connect single sign-on settings (`OidcSsoOptions`) that
`GET /api/sso-settings` returns. The client secret is never returned, as with every
other secret; Ninlil.Web.Models.OidcSsoSettingsDetail.ClientSecretConfigured says whether one is set. A
`PATCH` accepts these fields with `clientSecret` in place of
Ninlil.Web.Models.OidcSsoSettingsDetail.ClientSecretConfigured.

enableSourcePortPool.description: Whether outbound UDP queries reuse a fixed pool of sockets rather than a new socket on a random port each time. Defaults to false because a new socket per query gets a fresh random source port.

poolSizePerAddressFamily.description: How many sockets, and so source ports, the pool keeps for each of IPv4 and IPv6. Defaults to 128.

excludedSourcePorts.description: Local source ports outbound sockets must not use, such as one another local service listens on. Empty by default.

OutboundQuerySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the outbound query settings (`OutboundQueryOptions`)
that `GET /api/outbound-query-settings` returns. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint
accepts the same fields.

requestedBy.description: The user name that requested it.

appliesAutomatically.description:
True when the runtime configuration file decides the storage settings, so Ninlil points it
at the target itself. False when an environment variable or another configuration source
decides, so the operator must change that source before the restart.

PendingStorageSwitchInfo.description:
This record describes a saved storage switch that has not run yet. It never carries a
connection string.

port.description: The port the UDP and TCP listeners bind to.

listenAddresses.description:
The local IP addresses the UDP and TCP listeners bind to, one socket per address. An empty
list (the default) means every address, through one dual-stack socket.

tcpIdleTimeout.description: How long a TCP connection may stay idle before the server closes it.

maxConcurrentTcpConnections.description: How many TCP connections the server accepts at once.

PlainTransportSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the plain DNS transport settings (`PlainProtocolOptions`) that
`GET /api/transport-settings/plain` returns. It has no `Enable` field because
plain DNS has none: it is the baseline transport and always starts. Every field needs a
listener restart.

name.description: The preset that was applied.

note.description:
A reminder that settings read through
Microsoft.Extensions.Options.IOptionsMonitor`1 take effect at once,
while the others the preset touched need a restart.

PresetApplyResult.description: This record is returned after a preset is applied (`POST /api/presets/{name}/apply`).

name.description: The preset's stable name, for example `"Baseline"`.

description.description: A short summary of what the preset changes and why.

configurationSettingCount.description: How many individual configuration values the preset overwrites.

filterListSubscriptionCount.description: How many block or allow list subscriptions the preset adds.

PresetSummary.description:
This record summarizes one built-in Ninlil.Dns.Server.Presets.PresetDefinition
for `GET /api/presets`. It leaves out the individual settings, since a preset is
applied as a whole, not inspected field by field.

defaultEnabled.description:
Whether PTR records are managed for a zone whose `ZoneEntity.AutoManagePtrRecords` is
unset. Defaults to false.

defaultIpv4ReverseZonePrefixBits.description:
The IPv4 reverse zone size, in prefix bits, for a zone whose
`ZoneEntity.PtrIpv4PrefixLength` is unset. Defaults to 24, one zone per octet
boundary; 25 to 30 use RFC 2317 classless zones. Only 24 to 30 are accepted.

defaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits.description:
The IPv6 reverse zone size, in prefix bits, for a zone whose
`ZoneEntity.PtrIpv6PrefixLength` is unset. Defaults to 64; only multiples of 4 from 16
to 124 are accepted.

PtrSyncSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the PTR sync defaults (`PtrSyncOptions`) that
`GET /api/ptr-sync-settings` returns: whether the A and AAAA records of a
`ZoneTypeEnum.Primary` or `ZoneTypeEnum.CloudPrimary` zone are mirrored as PTR
records into the matching reverse zone, and how reverse zones are sized. Each applies when
the zone's own setting is unset. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

deletedCount.description: How many entries were permanently removed.

QueryLogClearResult.description: This class carries the outcome of clearing the query log (`DELETE /api/query-log`).

enable.description: Whether answered queries are written to the query log. Defaults to true.

retentionPeriod.description: How long a query log entry is kept. Defaults to 30 days.

maxRetainedEntries.description: The most entries the query log may hold. Defaults to 1,000,000.

cleanupInterval.description: How often the retention sweep runs. Defaults to 1 hour.

QueryLoggingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the query logging settings (`QueryLoggingOptions`)
that `GET /api/query-logging-settings` returns. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint
accepts the same fields.

RabbitMqBrokerSettingsDetail.description:
This record carries the `RabbitMqEventBrokerOptions` settings without
`Password`. A `GET` never returns the password, as with every other secret, even
though this one is stored in the plaintext configuration file rather than encrypted with an
`IDataProtector`.

enable.description: Whether rate limiting is applied. Defaults to false.

queriesPerSecond.description: The steady query rate allowed per client. Defaults to 20.

burstSize.description: How many queries a client may send at once above the steady rate. Defaults to 40.

trackedClientExpiry.description: How long an idle client's bucket, or a subnet's window, is kept. Defaults to 5 minutes.

cleanupInterval.description: How often expired buckets are removed. Defaults to 1 minute.

maxTrackedClients.description: The most client addresses, and separately subnets, tracked at once; beyond it new ones go unthrottled. Defaults to 100,000.

subnetPrefixLengthIPv4.description: The IPv4 prefix length clients are grouped by for subnet limits. Defaults to 24.

subnetPrefixLengthIPv6.description: The IPv6 prefix length clients are grouped by for subnet limits. Defaults to 56.

subnetSampleWindow.description: The window subnet query counts are measured over. Defaults to 10 seconds.

subnetUdpQueryLimit.description: How many UDP queries a subnet may send per window. Defaults to 500.

subnetTcpQueryLimit.description: How many TCP queries a subnet may send per window. Defaults to 100.

subnetTruncatePercentage.description: The percentage of over-limit UDP queries answered with a truncated response instead of dropped. Defaults to 50.

subnetBypassCidrs.description: CIDR networks the subnet limits never apply to (the per-client limit still does). Empty by default.

lastModifiedUtc.description: When the settings were last written, or null if never.

originatingNodeId.description: The cluster node the last write came from, or null if never written.

RateLimitingSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the DNS rate limiting settings (`DnsRateLimitOptions`)
that `GET /api/rate-limiting-settings` returns. It covers the per-client token bucket
and the per-subnet response limits. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts every
field except the last two, which are read-only cluster sync bookkeeping.

RecordDetail.description:
This class carries a record, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints under
`/api/zones/{zoneId}/records`. The fields mean what they mean in
Ninlil.Web.Models.RecordWriteRequest.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

RecordDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: The record's owner name.

data.description:
The record's type-specific data, shaped like the record type's data model: for example
`{ "address": "203.0.113.5" }` for an `A` record or
`{ "preference": 10, "exchange": "mail.example.com" }` for an `MX` record.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the record.

excludeFromSync.description:
Whether the record is local-only: never sent in a zone transfer or cloud push, and never
overwritten or deleted by an incoming one.

RecordWriteRequest.description:
This class carries every writable field of a `RecordEntity`, used to create a record
(`POST /api/zones/{zoneId}/records`) and to fully replace one
(`PUT /api/zones/{zoneId}/records/{id}`).

codes.description:
The 10 new codes, each usable once at `POST /api/auth/login/two-factor` with
`"RecoveryCode"` as the Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorLoginRequest.Provider. Generating a
batch invalidates every code from earlier batches.

RecoveryCodesResult.description:
This class carries a new batch of single-use recovery codes
(`POST /api/auth/two-factor/recovery-codes/generate`, which requires two-factor
authentication to be enabled). They are a fallback when the authenticator app or e-mail is
unavailable. Like every generated secret (a TSIG key's secret, a webhook's signing
secret), they are shown once, in this response; afterwards only
Ninlil.Web.Models.TwoFactorStatus.RecoveryCodesRemaining reports on them.

RecursiveRootHintServerDetail.description:
This record is one `RootHintServerOption` entry in
Ninlil.Web.Models.RecursiveSettingsDetail.RootHintServersOverride: a root server's name and
addresses. An empty override list uses the built-in internet root hints.

RecursiveSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the recursive resolver settings
(`RecursiveServerOptions`) that `GET /api/recursive-settings` returns. A
`PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields. The two override lists are read
once at startup or first seed, so the GET shows the saved lists, which may not be the ones
in use; every other field takes effect at once. `RecursiveServerOptions` documents
each field and its default.

`InsecureDomains` is the list of Insecure domains (negative trust anchors) in
    force: a query for a name at or below one skips DNSSEC validation and is never answered
    with AD. It is the built-in list while `UseCustomInsecureDomains` is
    false. A `PATCH` with an array replaces the whole list and makes
    it custom; a `PATCH` with null restores the built-in list.
    `BuiltInInsecureDomains` is that built-in list (`home.arpa`, `internal`
    and the locally-served reverse zones of RFC 6303), for comparison and for a "restore
    defaults" action; it is read-only.

RecursiveTrustAnchorDetail.description:
This record is one `TrustAnchorOption` entry in
Ninlil.Web.Models.RecursiveSettingsDetail.TrustAnchorsOverride: a root DS record given as key
tag, algorithm, digest type and hex digest. An empty override list uses the IANA root
anchors. The list only seeds the trust anchor store when its state file is missing.

refreshToken.description:
The refresh token to act on. Omit it (send `{}`) to act on the browser's refresh
cookie instead; the response then rotates that cookie rather than returning a token.

RefreshRequest.description:
This class carries the refresh token a caller exchanges for a new access token, or revokes
at sign-out.

host.description: The database server's host name or IP address.

databaseName.description: The name of an existing database that is empty or whose Ninlil data may be replaced.

password.description:
The password to authenticate with. It is used only during the switch call and is not
stored by the REST layer or returned by any `GET`.

encryptionMode.description:
The engine's connection encryption mode, as the name of one of its driver's values (see
Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler).

RelationalStorageConnectionFields.description:
This record carries the connection fields `POST /api/storage/switch` accepts for a
PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server target; the three server engines share this shape. The
accepted Ninlil.Web.Models.RelationalStorageConnectionFields.EncryptionMode values differ by engine: each is checked against
that engine's driver enum by
Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler, which lists them.

enable.description: Whether forwarded headers are honored at all.

knownProxies.description: The individual IP addresses allowed to supply a forwarded client address.

knownNetworks.description: The CIDR networks allowed to supply a forwarded client address.

sharedSecretHeaderName.description: The request header a shared secret is read from, when one is set.

sharedSecretConfigured.description: Whether a shared secret is set.

lastModifiedUtc.description:
When the settings were last written through the REST API, used by cluster config sync, or
null if they never have been.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the settings were last written on, or null together
with Ninlil.Web.Models.ReverseProxySettingsDetail.LastModifiedUtc.

enable.description: Whether rewrites are applied. Defaults to false.

timeToLiveSeconds.description: The TTL, in seconds, of a synthesized rewrite answer. Defaults to 300.

RewriteSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the rewrite engine settings (`DnsRewriteOptions`)
that `GET /api/rewrite-settings` returns. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts
the same fields. The rewrites themselves are a separate resource
(`DnsRewritesController`); this record holds the on/off switch and the TTL of
synthesized answers, which apply to all of them.

RolePermissionRequest.description:
This class carries one permission to grant or revoke on a role
(`POST` or `DELETE /api/roles/{id}/permissions`).

name.description: The role's display name.

permissions.description: Every permission string the role grants.

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the role was last created or modified on, or null if
it was never written with clustering enabled.

clusterConflictNote.description:
An explanation of a cluster role-name collision this role lost, or null
when there was none (almost always).

lastModifiedUtc.description: When the role was last created or modified.

RoleSummary.description:
This class carries a role with every permission it grants, as returned by the endpoints of
`/api/roles`. The cluster fields mean what they mean on `UserSummary`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

RoleSummaryPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

note.description:
When the change takes effect: at once, after a listener or service restart, or after a
process restart (see Ninlil.Web.Options.RuntimeConfigurationOptions).

RuntimeSettingsWriteResult.description:
This record is returned after a runtime settings `PATCH` is written to the
configuration file. Its constants are the notes the settings controllers choose from,
each saying when the written change takes effect.

description.description: A short description of what enabling the entry does.

sourceDocumentationUrl.description: The engine's official documentation page the entry's rewrite mappings come from.

hostnameCount.description: How many hostnames the entry redirects when enabled, without listing every mapping.

isEnabled.description:
Whether every one of the entry's mappings exists as an enabled `DnsRewriteEntity`
with the matching scope (global, or the client or client group the request named).

SafeSearchDetail.description:
This class carries one Safe Search catalog entry with whether it is enabled, the response
shape of `GET /api/safe-search`.

pollInterval.description: How often the background loop checks whether a secondary zone is due for a refresh. Defaults to 15 seconds.

defaultRetryInterval.description: How long to wait before retrying a zone with no local SOA (so no Retry value), whose primaries were all unreachable, or that is a stub zone. Defaults to 30 seconds.

SecondaryZoneRefreshSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the secondary zone refresh settings
(`SecondaryZoneRefreshOptions`) that `GET /api/secondary-zone-refresh-settings`
returns. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

enableAutomaticCheck.description: Whether the server checks Ninlil.Web.Models.SelfUpdateSettingsDetail.ReleaseFeedUrl periodically. Defaults to true.

releaseFeedUrl.description: The release feed URL to check, or an empty string (the default) if none is set.

checkInterval.description: How often a check is due. Defaults to 24 hours.

SelfUpdateSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the REST shape of the update check settings (`SelfUpdateOptions`) that
`GET /api/self-update-settings` returns. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts
the same fields.

configured.description: Whether a release feed URL is set.

currentVersion.description: The running version, as a plain dotted string.

latestKnownVersion.description:
The newest version the release feed has reported, as a plain dotted string, or
null if no check has succeeded.

updateAvailable.description: Whether a release newer than CurrentVersion is known.

releaseUrl.description: A human-facing URL for the latest known release.

releaseNotes.description: Free-text release notes for the latest known release.

lastCheckedAtUtc.description: When a check was last attempted, or null if none has run.

lastCheckError.description: A short description of why the last check failed, or null if it succeeded.

updateInstructions.description:
Plain-language guidance on how to update. The server does not update itself, so the UI
shows these instructions rather than an update button (see
`Controllers.SelfUpdateController`).

SelfUpdateStatusDetail.description:
This record is what the update checker knows, as returned by `GET /api/self-update`
and `POST /api/self-update/check`: whether an update is available, with enough context
to act on it. `Controllers.SelfUpdateController` explains how an update is applied.

smtpPort.description: The SMTP server's port. Defaults to 587.

useTls.description: Whether the connection to the SMTP server uses TLS. Defaults to true.

username.description: The username to authenticate with, or empty if the server accepts anonymous connections.

passwordConfigured.description:
Whether a password is stored (encrypted) or supplied through the environment. The
password itself is never returned, as with every other secret.

fromAddress.description: The e-mail address messages are sent from.

fromDisplayName.description: The display name messages are sent from. Defaults to "Ninlil".

publicBaseUrl.description:
The address users open the admin console at, which password-reset links point to. Empty
means no reset link can be sent. Links never use the request's Host header.

passwordFromEnvironment.description:
Whether a plaintext password is set outside the admin console (the
`NINLIL_EMAIL_PASSWORD` environment variable). It overrides the stored password, so a
password saved on this page has no effect while it is set.

passwordUnreadable.description:
Whether a stored password exists but this server's Data Protection key ring cannot decrypt
it (the key ring changed). Sending mail fails until the password is entered again or
`NINLIL_EMAIL_PASSWORD` is set.

SmtpSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the SMTP settings (`EmailSenderOptions`) that
`GET /api/smtp-settings` returns: the server e-mail is sent through, for two-factor
codes and password reset links. A `PATCH` accepts these fields with `password`
in place of Ninlil.Web.Models.SmtpSettingsDetail.PasswordConfigured.

filePath.description: The path of the SQLite database file to switch to.

SqliteStorageConnectionFields.description:
This record carries the connection fields `POST /api/storage/switch` accepts for a
SQLite target: one file path the process must be able to create and write.

enabled.description:
Whether the OpenID Connect authentication scheme is registered in the running process.
This can differ from `OidcSsoOptions.Enable` until a restart (see
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.SsoController.Get).

displayName.description: The label for the single sign-on button.

SsoStatusResult.description:
This record tells an anonymous caller, the admin console's login page before anyone signs
in, whether single sign-on through OpenID Connect is available and how to label its button
(`GET /api/auth/sso`).

name.description: The health check's registered name (for example `storage` or `transports`).

description.description: A human-readable description of the component's state.

error.description: The message of an exception the check raised, or null.

StatusComponent.description:
This class carries one health check's result, as listed in
Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Components.

components.description: The per-subsystem breakdown, present only for an authenticated caller with `status:read`.

StatusResponse.description:
This class carries the response of `GET /status`. A caller without the
`status:read` permission, including an anonymous one, gets only Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Status,
with Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Componentsnull. A caller with it gets both.
Ninlil.Web.Models.StatusResponse.Status is aggregated from the same health checks the components report.

StorageEngineSwitchApiRequest.description:
This record is the request body of `POST /api/storage/switch`: structured connection
fields per engine rather than a free-text connection string. Only the section matching
Ninlil.Web.Models.StorageEngineSwitchApiRequest.TargetEngine needs to be filled in;
Ninlil.Web.Services.Storage.StorageConnectionStringAssembler reads that section and
ignores the others.

hosts.description:
The `host:port` entries of the primary connection: one per member of a multi-host
PostgreSQL or MySQL string or a MongoDB replica set URL, the data source of a SQL Server
string, and none for SQLite (a file, not a server).

StoragePrimaryStatus.description:
This record names the servers the process writes to. It carries host names and ports
only, never a user name, password or database name.

configured.description: Always true; the whole object is null when no split is configured.

eligible.description:
True when the replica serves reads: its last check found the lag within
`Storage:ReadReplica:MaxLagSeconds` and the schema current. False before the first
check; reads then go to the primary.

lagSeconds.description: The measured lag in seconds, or null when it is unknown or not yet measured.

schemaCurrent.description: Whether the replica has the primary's schema version.

lastCheckedAtUtc.description: When the replica was last checked, or null before the first check.

reason.description:
Why the replica serves no reads, in plain words, or an empty string when it does. It never
contains a connection string.

readsToReplica.description:
How many requests and background reads (counted once per database scope) went to the
replica since the process started.

readsToPrimary.description:
How many database scopes used the primary since the process started. This counts every
scope that used it: writes, startup work, sign-in and DHCP as well as reads that fell
back because the replica was not eligible or the user wrote a moment ago.

hosts.description:
The `host:port` entries of the read connection. Empty on MongoDB, where the replica
set members are the primary's hosts and ReadPreference chooses among
them.

readPreference.description:
The MongoDB read preference used for replica-eligible reads (for example
