`SecondaryPreferred`), or null on the relational engines.

StorageReadReplicaStatus.description:
This record describes the read replica: whether Ninlil may read from it now and how many
reads went where. The numbers come from the latest check of the replica health monitor
(every `Storage:ReadReplica:LagCheckIntervalSeconds`) and from counters that start at
zero when the process starts.

switchSupportedEngines.description:
The engines `POST /api/storage/switch` accepts as a target: the four relational
engines Entity Framework Core serves with one model.
Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.StorageEngineEnum.MongoDb is not among them. It uses a separate repository
implementation chosen at startup.

StorageStatus.description:
This record describes the active storage engine and any storage switch that is waiting for
the next start or has just run (`GET /api/storage`). It leaves out every connection
string, which may contain a password, as the API does with every credential.

succeeded.description: Whether the data was copied and the target is in use.

rowsCopied.description: The number of rows copied, 0 when the switch failed.

message.description: A short, operator-readable account of the result.

StorageSwitchOutcome.description: This record reports how a storage switch ended during this process's startup.

appliesAutomatically.description:
True when the runtime configuration file decides the storage settings, so Ninlil points it
at the target itself during the copy. False when an environment variable or another
configuration source decides; Note then names what to set.

targetHasData.description: Whether the target database already holds Ninlil data. The copy replaces that data.

note.description: What the operator does next, in plain words.

StorageSwitchScheduled.description:
This record is the 202 answer of `POST /api/storage/switch`: the switch is saved and
runs at the next start. Nothing has been copied yet.

pfxPath.description:
The path to an operator-provided PKCS#12 file with the certificate and private key. Empty
means the server generates and manages a self-signed certificate.

pfxPasswordConfigured.description:
Whether Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions.PfxPassword has a value. The password itself is
never returned, as with every other secret.

selfSignedSubjectAlternativeNames.description:
The subject alternative names of the self-signed certificate, which is generated only when
Ninlil.Web.Models.TlsCertificateSettingsDetail.PfxPath is empty.

certificateReloadPollInterval.description:
How often the transport's Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.ReloadableTlsCertificateProvider checks whether the
certificate file has been replaced on disk.

allowedProtocols.description:
The TLS protocol versions the handshake accepts, by name (for example
`["Tls12", "Tls13"]`). An empty list means
System.Security.Authentication.SslProtocols.None: the operating system picks
its default (see Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions.AllowedProtocols).

TlsCertificateSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the server certificate configuration of a TLS-based transport
(Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions), used by DNS-over-TLS and DNS-over-QUIC.
DNS-over-HTTPS runs on the shared Kestrel listener and uses its certificate, so it has no
such field (see Ninlil.Web.Models.DnsOverHttpsSettingsDetail). The shape is the one
Ninlil.Dns.Server.Core.Certificates.TlsCertificateOptions uses: a PFX file path, or a self-signed certificate the
server manages. Key material cannot be uploaded through the API.

name.description:
The key's name, matched against the key name in a signed message. It is stored and returned
in lowercase, because DNS names compare without case and BIND lowercases key names on the
wire.

algorithmName.description:
The key's MAC algorithm: `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha384` or
`hmac-sha512`, with or without the trailing dot. It is stored without the dot, and
`hmac-sha256` is used when this is omitted or blank.

secret.description:
The shared secret, base64-encoded. When omitted, a random secret as long as the
algorithm's MAC is generated (32 bytes for HMAC-SHA256).
Either way the plaintext secret is shown once, in this endpoint's response, and never
again.

isDisabled.description: Whether the key starts out disabled.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

TsigKeyCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new TSIG key
(`POST /api/tsig-keys`).

TsigKeyCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a newly created TSIG key with its plaintext shared secret. It is the
only response that includes Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyCreateResponse.Secret: like every secret-bearing entity, a
secret is revealed once at creation and omitted afterwards.

name.description: The key's name, in lowercase.

algorithmName.description: The key's MAC algorithm, such as `hmac-sha256`.

isClusterKey.description:
Whether clustering created the key (a peer's channel key, or an invite key not yet used).
Such a key can be disabled and commented but not renamed or deleted, and it never
signs or verifies zone transfers or updates.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the key was last changed, or null if never.

TsigKeyDetail.description:
This class carries a TSIG key without its secret, as returned by the list and get
endpoints and nested in Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyCreateResponse, the one response that
includes the secret.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

TsigKeyDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: The key's name; stored in lowercase.

algorithmName.description:
The key's MAC algorithm; required here. One of `hmac-sha1`, `hmac-sha256`,
`hmac-sha384` or `hmac-sha512`.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the key.

TsigKeyWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to fully replace an existing TSIG key's metadata
(`PUT /api/tsig-keys/{id}`). The shared secret cannot be changed this way: a secret is
shown only when a key is created, and a `PUT` answers `204` with no body. To
rotate the secret, delete the key and create it again.

defaultFudgeSeconds.description:
The fudge, in seconds. The options property is a System.UInt16, but it is shown as
an System.Int32 because JSON has no unsigned 16-bit type; a `PATCH` rejects
values outside 0 to 65535.

TsigSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the TSIG settings (`TsigServiceOptions`) that
`GET /api/tsig-settings` returns: the clock skew tolerance (fudge) written into every
message the server signs. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same field.

code.description: The time-based (authenticator app) or e-mailed verification code.

TwoFactorCodeRequest.description:
This class carries one verification code, used to confirm a newly enrolled authenticator
and to disable two-factor authentication.

TwoFactorEmailCodeRequest.description:
This class carries the request for an e-mailed second-factor code during the pending
second-factor step of a sign-in.

code.description: The time-based (authenticator app) or e-mailed verification code.

provider.description:
Which second factor Code comes from: `"Authenticator"`,
`"Email"` or `"RecoveryCode"`. A recovery code is one of the caller's single-use
fallback codes from `POST /api/auth/two-factor/recovery-codes/generate`; this call
redeems it, so it cannot be used again. Any other value is treated as
`"Authenticator"`.

rememberMe.description: The same choice Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginRequest.RememberMe describes, repeated for this final step.

TwoFactorLoginRequest.description:
This class carries the second-factor code a caller submits to finish a sign-in that
Ninlil.Web.Models.LoginResponse.RequiresTwoFactor flagged as still pending.

isEnabled.description: Whether a second factor is required at sign-in.

hasAuthenticator.description:
Whether an authenticator shared secret has been generated for the account, whether or not
two-factor sign-in is required. The UI uses it to say "re-enroll" rather than "enroll".

canReceiveEmailCode.description:
Whether the account has a confirmed e-mail address that
`POST /api/auth/two-factor/email/send` can deliver a code to.

recoveryCodesRemaining.description:
How many of the account's single-use recovery codes are unused; zero when none have been
generated. The UI should prompt for a new batch when this runs low.

TwoFactorStatus.description:
This class carries the caller's two-factor enrollment state
(`GET /api/auth/two-factor/status`).

UpdateRoleRequest.description:
This class carries the settings that can be changed on a role
(`PUT /api/roles/{id}`). Only the description can change; the name is fixed.

displayName.description: The account's new friendly display name.

isDisabled.description: Whether the account should be disabled (rejected at sign-in).

UpdateUserRequest.description:
This class carries the settings an administrator can change on a user account
(`PUT /api/users/{id}`). Passwords are changed through separate endpoints.

UserAppearancePreferenceDetail.description:
This record is the caller's appearance preference, returned by
`GET /api/appearance-settings/me`: their override for each field, if any, and the
value the admin console should render after falling back to the server-wide default.

UserPermissionRequest.description:
This class carries one permission to grant or revoke directly on a user, outside any role
(`POST` or `DELETE /api/users/{id}/permissions`).

email.description: The account's e-mail address, if any. Read-only here.

displayName.description: The account's friendly display name, if any.

phoneNumber.description: The account's phone number, if any.

UserProfileDetail.description:
This class carries the caller's self-service profile, read through
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.GetMine and changed through
M:Ninlil.Web.Controllers.UsersController.PatchMine(System.Text.Json.JsonElement), which accepts only the display name
and phone number. Ninlil.Web.Models.UserProfileDetail.Email is shown, and lets the Profile page compute the
Gravatar hash, but cannot be changed here: changing an e-mail address would need a
re-verification flow that does not exist. An administrator can change it through
`UpdateUserRequest`.

roleName.description: The name of the role to grant or revoke.

UserRoleAssignmentRequest.description: This class carries the role to grant a user (`POST /api/users/{id}/roles`).

email.description: The account's e-mail address, if any.

displayName.description: The account's friendly display name, if any.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether the account requires a second authentication factor.

roles.description: The names of every role the account holds.

directPermissions.description:
The permissions granted to the account directly, not through a role (the counterpart of
Ninlil.Web.Models.RoleSummary.Permissions).

originatingNodeId.description:
The cluster node the account was last created or modified on, or null
if it was never written with clustering enabled. The admin console shows it with
Ninlil.Web.Models.UserSummary.LastModifiedUtc in `ClusterSyncInfoComponent`, as for other synced
entities.

clusterConflictNote.description:
An explanation of a cluster username collision this account lost, so an administrator can
see it was renamed or overwritten rather than silently dropped or merged (see
`UserEntity.ClusterConflictNote`). null when there was none
(almost always).

lastModifiedUtc.description:
When the account was last created or modified
(`AuditableEntityBaseExtensions.GetLastModifiedUtc()`).

UserSummary.description:
This class carries a user account, as returned by the administrative endpoints of
`/api/users`.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

UserSummaryPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

httpPort.description: The plain HTTP port. Defaults to 80.

listenAddresses.description: The IP addresses both ports bind, as configured; empty (the default) means every address.

WebListenSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the web listener settings (`WebListenOptions`) that
`GET /api/web-listen-settings` returns: the ports and certificate shared by the REST
API, the SignalR hub and DNS-over-HTTPS. A `PATCH` accepts the same fields, with the
certificate password in place of `PfxPasswordConfigured`. Every change needs a process
restart (see Ninlil.Web.Models.RuntimeSettingsWriteResult.WebListenRestartRequiredNote).

subscriptionId.description: The identifier of the subscription the delivery is for.

subscriptionName.description:
The subscription's name when the delivery was created, so the record stays meaningful if
the subscription is renamed or deleted.

eventTypeName.description: The registered event type name the delivery carries (for example `"DnsZoneChanged"`).

payloadJson.description:
The JSON request body sent on every attempt. It is captured once, when the delivery is
created, so a retry, even after a restart, sends the same bytes.

attemptCount.description: How many attempts have been made so far.

maxAttempts.description:
The most attempts the delivery may make: the subscription's
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionDetail.MaxDeliveryAttempts when the delivery was created.

lastAttemptedAtUtc.description: When the last attempt was made, or null if none has been.

nextRetryDueUtc.description: When the next retry is due, or null once Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetail.Status is final.

lastHttpStatusCode.description:
The HTTP status code the receiver returned to the last attempt, or null
if that attempt failed before a response arrived.

lastErrorMessage.description: A short description of the last failure, or null if the last attempt succeeded.

completedAtUtc.description: When the delivery reached a final status, or null while it is pending.

createdAtUtc.description: When the delivery was first recorded.

WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetail.description:
This class carries one webhook delivery and its attempts so far, as returned by
`GET /api/webhooks/{id}/delivery-attempts` from the stored
`WebhookDeliveryAttemptEntity` history. It is read-only: only
`WebhookDeliveryService` and `WebhookDeliveryRetrySweepService` write deliveries,
as they make attempts.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

WebhookDeliveryAttemptDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

initialRetryDelay.description: The wait before the first retry of a failed delivery, doubled for each later retry. Defaults to 1 second.

maxRetryDelay.description: The longest wait between retries. Defaults to 30 seconds.

requestTimeout.description: How long one delivery request may take. Defaults to 10 seconds; a change applies as pooled HTTP handlers are replaced.

WebhookDeliverySettingsDetail.description:
This record is the webhook delivery settings (`WebhookDeliveryOptions`) that
`GET /api/webhook-delivery-settings` returns: the retry backoff and HTTP timeout every
subscription's deliveries use. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts the same fields.

name.description: An operator-chosen, human-readable, unique name for the subscription.

targetUrl.description: The absolute http or https URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description:
The event types to deliver, by their `DnsServerEventTypeRegistry` name (for example
`"DnsZoneChanged"`). Each is checked against the registry before saving.

authCredentials.description:
The delivery POST's credentials, required when Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.AuthMode is not `None`:
`{"BearerToken":"..."}` for `Bearer`, or
`{"Username":"...","Password":"..."}` for `Basic`. They always come from the
operator (the server never generates them) and are returned once, in this endpoint's
response.

enableHmacSigning.description:
Whether deliveries are signed with an HMAC secret in the `X-Ninlil-Signature` header,
so the receiver can verify them.

hmacSigningSecret.description:
The HMAC signing secret, used only when Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.EnableHmacSigning is
true. When omitted, a random 32-byte secret is generated. Either way the
plaintext secret is shown once, in this endpoint's response. Neither `PUT` nor
`PATCH` can change it, as with a TSIG key's secret (see
Ninlil.Web.Models.TsigKeyWriteRequest); to rotate or remove it, delete and recreate the
subscription.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description:
How many times one event is attempted before the delivery is given up. Must be positive;
defaults to 5.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the subscription.

WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to create a new outbound webhook subscription
(`POST /api/webhooks`). Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse is the only
place Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.AuthCredentials and the HMAC signing secret are ever returned.

authCredentials.description:
The delivery POST's credentials, or null when
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionDetail.AuthMode is `None`.

hmacSigningSecret.description:
The HMAC signing secret, as supplied or generated, or null when signing
is off.

WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.description:
This class carries a newly created webhook subscription with its plaintext credentials
and, if signing is on, its plaintext HMAC signing secret. It is the only response that
includes either: like every secret-bearing entity, a secret is revealed once at creation.

name.description: The subscription's name.

targetUrl.description: The absolute URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description: The event types the subscription receives.

hasHmacSigningSecret.description:
Whether the subscription has an HMAC signing secret, so a caller can tell that signing is
on without the secret being exposed.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description: How many times one event is attempted.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the subscription.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the subscription was last modified, or null if never.

WebhookSubscriptionDetail.description:
This class carries a webhook subscription without its secrets, as returned by the list and
get endpoints and nested in Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse, the one
response that includes Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.AuthCredentials and
Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateResponse.HmacSigningSecret.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

WebhookSubscriptionDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

name.description: The subscription's name.

targetUrl.description: The absolute URL every matching event is POSTed to.

eventTypeNames.description: The event types to deliver, replacing the whole set.

authCredentials.description: The delivery POST's credentials, replacing the stored ones.

maxDeliveryAttempts.description: How many times one event is attempted. Must be positive; defaults to 5.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the subscription.

WebhookSubscriptionWriteRequest.description:
This class carries the fields used to fully replace an existing webhook subscription's
settings and credentials (`PUT /api/webhooks/{id}`). Unlike a TSIG key's generated
secret, Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionWriteRequest.AuthCredentials comes from the operator, who already knows the value,
so a `PUT` replaces it too, as with Ninlil.Web.Models.CloudProviderCredentialWriteRequest.
The HMAC signing secret (see Ninlil.Web.Models.WebhookSubscriptionCreateRequest.HmacSigningSecret)
cannot be changed this way; delete and recreate the subscription instead.

recordsAdded.description: How many CAA records the pass created.

recordsRemoved.description: How many CAA records the pass removed as no longer wanted.

skipped.description:
Whether the pass did nothing (see SkipReason). A pass that ran but
found nothing to change reports false with zero counts.

skipReason.description: Why the pass was skipped, set only when Skipped is true.

ZoneCaaReconciliationResponse.description:
This record is the response of `POST /api/zones/{id}/reconcile-caa`: what one
on-demand CAA reconciliation did, or why it did nothing. It copies
`Server.Acme.Caa.CaaReconciliationResult` so the internal service type is not exposed
over REST, as Ninlil.Web.Models.ZoneCatalogMembersResponse does for the catalog service.

memberZoneNames.description: Every member zone name the catalog lists, in alphabetical order.

ZoneCatalogMembersResponse.description:
This class carries the member zone names of one catalog zone, the response of
`GET /api/zones/{id}/catalog-members`.

catalogZoneId.description: The identifier of the Ninlil.Dns.Common.Enum.ZoneTypeEnum.Catalog zone to join.

ZoneCatalogMembershipRequest.description:
This class carries the catalog zone a zone should join, the request body of
`POST /api/zones/{id}/catalog-membership`.

name.description: The zone's fully-qualified name, without a trailing dot.

isDnssecSigned.description: Whether the zone is signed with DNSSEC.

nsec3Iterations.description: How many additional times a signed zone's NSEC3 chain hashes.

nsec3SaltHex.description: A signed zone's NSEC3 salt, as hexadecimal text.

primaryServerAddresses.description: The name servers a secondary or stub zone transfers from.

forwarderAddresses.description: The addresses a forwarder zone sends every query to.

notifyAddresses.description: The secondaries the zone sends NOTIFY messages to.

tsigKeyName.description: The TSIG key the zone signs its transfer requests with.

dynamicUpdateEnabled.description: Whether the zone accepts RFC 2136 dynamic updates.

updateTsigKeyNames.description:
The TSIG keys allowed to send dynamic updates to the zone (lowercase, no trailing dot). An
empty list accepts no key.

transferTsigKeyNames.description: The TSIG keys allowed to transfer the zone (AXFR and IXFR). An empty list accepts no key.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the zone.

cloudProviderCredentialId.description: The credential a cloud zone syncs with.

cloudProviderZoneId.description: The zone's identifier at its cloud provider.

cloudSyncInterval.description: How often a cloud zone is synced.

autoManageCaaRecords.description:
Whether CAA auto-management keeps the zone's CAA records in step.
null inherits `CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

caaIssuerDomain.description:
The CA issuer domain CAA auto-management writes. null inherits
`CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultIssuerDomain`.

autoManagePtrRecords.description:
Whether PTR sync mirrors the zone's A and AAAA records into the matching reverse zone.
null inherits `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

ptrIpv4PrefixLength.description:
The zone's IPv4 reverse zone size, in prefix bits. null inherits
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv4ReverseZonePrefixBits`.

ptrIpv6PrefixLength.description:
The zone's IPv6 reverse zone size, in prefix bits. null inherits
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits`.

updatedAtUtc.description: When the zone was last updated, or null if never.

memberOfCatalogZoneId.description:
The RFC 9432 catalog zone this zone belongs to, or null if none.
Read-only: it changes only through `POST` and
`DELETE /api/zones/{id}/catalog-membership`.

validateDnssec.description:
Whether answers forwarded for a forwarder zone are validated with DNSSEC. Off by default,
because a private zone has no chain of trust from the public root. The global DNSSEC
validation setting must also be on, and names on the Insecure domain list are never
validated.

ZoneDetail.description:
This class carries a zone, as returned by the list, get and write endpoints of
`/api/zones`. The fields mean what they mean in Ninlil.Web.Models.ZoneWriteRequest.

skip.description: How many items were skipped before this page began.

take.description: The maximum number of items this page could contain.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across every page.

ZoneDetailPagedResult.description:
This class wraps one page of a larger list, the shape the paginated list endpoints return.
Paging is by offset and limit: with a capped page size that is enough at homelab and
small-office scale, so cursor-based paging is not needed.

recordsAdded.description:
How many PTR and delegation CNAME records the pass created, across every reverse zone and,
for a classless IPv4 grouping, every RFC 2317 delegating parent zone.

recordsRemoved.description: How many such records the pass removed as no longer wanted.

reverseZonesTouched.description: How many distinct zones the pass created, wrote to or checked for stale records.

skipped.description:
Whether the pass did nothing (see SkipReason). A pass that ran but
found nothing to change reports false with zero counts.

skipReason.description: Why the pass was skipped, set only when Skipped is true.

ZonePtrReconciliationResponse.description:
This record is the response of `POST /api/zones/{id}/reconcile-ptr`: what one
on-demand PTR sync did, or why it did nothing. It copies
`Server.Authoritative.Ptr.PtrReconciliationResult`, as
Ninlil.Web.Models.ZoneCaaReconciliationResponse does for CAA.

signatureValidityPeriod.description: How long a new signature stays valid. Defaults to 30 days.

inceptionOffset.description: How far before the signing time a signature's inception is backdated, to allow for clock skew. Defaults to 1 hour.

refreshBeforeExpiration.description: How long before a zone's earliest signature expires the zone is re-signed. Defaults to 5 days.

pollInterval.description: How often the re-signing loop checks whether a signed zone is due. Defaults to 6 hours.

ZoneSigningSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the zone signing timing (`ZoneSigningOptions`) that
`GET /api/zone-signing-settings` returns: what `ZoneSigningService` signs with
and `DnssecResigningBackgroundService` re-signs by. A `PATCH` to the same
endpoint accepts the same fields.

primaryPort.description: The port plain transfers and SOA checks connect to on a primary. Defaults to 53.

connectTimeout.description: How long connecting to a primary may take. Defaults to 5 seconds.

readTimeout.description: How long to wait for each part of a transfer response. Defaults to 10 seconds.

soaQueryTimeout.description: How long the SOA serial check may take. Defaults to 3 seconds.

ZoneTransferClientSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the zone transfer client settings (`ZoneTransferClientOptions`) that
`GET /api/zone-transfer-client-settings` returns: how the server, as a secondary,
pulls AXFR and IXFR transfers from a primary. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts
the same fields.

recordsPerMessage.description: The most records put in one transfer message. Defaults to 100.

ZoneTransferSettingsDetail.description:
This record is the zone transfer settings (`ZoneTransferOptions`) that
`GET /api/zone-transfer-settings` returns: how the AXFR and IXFR responses the server
sends to secondaries are split into messages. A `PATCH` to the same endpoint accepts
the same field.

name.description: The zone's fully-qualified name, without a trailing dot.

isDnssecSigned.description: Whether the zone is signed with DNSSEC.

nsec3Iterations.description: How many additional times a signed zone's NSEC3 chain hashes.

nsec3SaltHex.description: A signed zone's NSEC3 salt, as hexadecimal text.

primaryServerAddresses.description: The name servers a secondary or stub zone transfers from.

forwarderAddresses.description: The addresses a forwarder zone sends every query to.

notifyAddresses.description: The secondaries the zone sends NOTIFY messages to.

tsigKeyName.description: The TSIG key the zone signs its transfer requests with.

dynamicUpdateEnabled.description: Whether the zone accepts RFC 2136 dynamic updates.

comments.description: Free-form operator notes about the zone.

cloudProviderCredentialId.description: The credential a cloud zone syncs with.

cloudProviderZoneId.description: The zone's identifier at its cloud provider.

cloudSyncInterval.description: How often a cloud zone is synced.

autoManageCaaRecords.description:
Whether CAA auto-management keeps the zone's CAA records in step.
null inherits `CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultEnabled`.

caaIssuerDomain.description:
The CA issuer domain CAA auto-management writes into the zone's CAA records.
null inherits `CaaAutoManagementOptions.DefaultIssuerDomain`.

autoManagePtrRecords.description:
Whether PTR sync mirrors the zone's A and AAAA records into the matching reverse zone.
null inherits `PtrSyncOptions.DefaultEnabled`, which defaults to
false: unlike CAA auto-management, PTR sync is opt-in.

ptrIpv4PrefixLength.description:
The zone's IPv4 reverse zone size, in prefix bits, or null to inherit
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv4ReverseZonePrefixBits`. 24 means one zone per octet
boundary; 25 to 30 use RFC 2317 classless delegation. Only `null` or 24 to 30 is
accepted.

ptrIpv6PrefixLength.description:
The zone's IPv6 reverse zone size, in prefix bits, or null to inherit
`PtrSyncOptions.DefaultIpv6ReverseZonePrefixBits`. Only `null` or a multiple of 4
from 16 to 124 is accepted.

updateTsigKeyNames.description:
The TSIG keys allowed to send dynamic updates to the zone (lowercase, no trailing dot). An
empty list accepts no key.

transferTsigKeyNames.description: The TSIG keys allowed to transfer the zone (AXFR and IXFR). An empty list accepts no key.

validateDnssec.description:
Whether answers forwarded for a forwarder zone are validated with DNSSEC. Off by default,
because a private zone has no chain of trust from the public root. The global DNSSEC
validation setting must also be on, and names on the Insecure domain list are never
validated.

ZoneWriteRequest.description:
This class carries every writable field of a `ZoneEntity`, used to create a zone
(`POST /api/zones`) and to fully replace one (`PUT /api/zones/{id}`). Creating a
zone adds no records, not even an SOA; records are managed through
`/api/zones/{zoneId}/records`.

Bearer.description: A JSON Web Token access token issued by POST /api/auth/login.
